# report-kit

**The backend that turns lab results into print-ready A4 reports, as PDF or HTML.**

Navy Sidebar and classic designs · header and pre-printed paper variants · 31 tests · scannable barcode and QR · no browser needed

[![Backend](https://img.shields.io/badge/side-backend-14264A)](#)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-14264A?logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](#)
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-strict-14264A?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](#)
[![Next.js · Fastify · Express](https://img.shields.io/badge/runs%20in-Next.js%20·%20Fastify%20·%20Express%20·%20Hono-C2410C)](#mount-it-anywhere)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-All%20rights%20reserved-E9A23B)](LICENSE)

[Quick start](#quick-start) · [API](#http-api) · [Templates](#tests-and-profiles) · [Configuration](#configuration) · [Printing](#printing) · [Docs](docs/api.md)

</div>

## Why

The lab used to produce reports by hand-editing Word files, one copy per test. `report-kit` replaces that with
data → document:

- **Data in, A4 out.** You send a patient and their results; the backend returns a PDF or HTML page.
- **Accurate by construction.** H/L flags come from the reference range, male/female ranges are picked
  automatically, and long reports split across pages with *Page X of Y*.
- **Prints the same everywhere.** HTML and PDF share one geometry file and one row-height model, so they
  break pages in exactly the same places.
- **Backend only.** Rendering, fonts, images and PDF generation run in Node.js. Your frontend stays
  free to look however you want; it talks to this backend through [`@mgpl-diagnostics/client`](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client).

## How it fits

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph Frontend["Your app (any UI)"]
    C["@mgpl-diagnostics/client<br/>headless SDK"]
  end
  subgraph Backend["Your backend (Node.js)"]
    A["createReportApi()<br/>or createMgplApi()"] --> R["report-kit<br/>templates · layout · react-pdf"]
    A --> I["invoice-kit<br/>billing"]
  end
  C -- "POST /report → PDF / HTML" --> A
  C -- "GET /templates" --> A
```

## Quick start

```bash
npm i @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit react react-dom
```

<details>
<summary>Installing from GitHub Packages</summary>

```ini
# .npmrc
@mgpl-diagnostics:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com
//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=${GITHUB_TOKEN}   # token with read:packages
```

or straight from git: `npm i github:mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit#v2.0.0` (built on install).
</details>

```ts
import { buildReport, renderReportPdf } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

const report = buildReport(
  { title: "Mrs", name: "Kavita Sharma", age: 32, sex: "Female", patientId: "MGPL1025", refDoctor: "Self" },
  [
    { template: "cbc", results: { hb: "10.8", wbc: "6700", plt: "2.45" } },
    { template: "kft", results: { urea: "28", creatinine: "0.9" } },
  ],
);

const pdf: Buffer = await renderReportPdf({ report, variant: "header" }); // A4, ready to print or email
```

## Mount it anywhere

The HTTP API is a standard `(Request) => Response` handler, so it fits every Node.js backend:

<table>
<tr><th>Next.js (App Router)</th><th>Fastify</th></tr>
<tr>
<td>

```ts
// app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts
import { createReportApi } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

const api = createReportApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" });
export { api as GET, api as POST, api as OPTIONS };
export const runtime = "nodejs";
```

</td>
<td>

```ts
import Fastify from "fastify";
import { mgplFastify } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/fastify";

const app = Fastify();
await app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl" });
await app.listen({ port: 4000 });
```

</td>
</tr>
<tr><th>Express / node:http</th><th>Hono · Bun · Deno</th></tr>
<tr>
<td>

```ts
import { createReportApi, toNodeHandler } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createReportApi()));
// mount before express.json()
```

</td>
<td>

```ts
const api = createReportApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" });
app.all("/api/mgpl/*", (c) => api(c.req.raw));      // Hono
Bun.serve({ fetch: api });                           // Bun
```

</td>
</tr>
</table>

Need invoices too? Mount [`createMgplApi()` from invoice-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit) instead. It serves every report route as well.

## HTTP API

| Method & route | Body / query | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /templates` | | every test with its result fields + profiles (build entry forms from it) |
| `POST /report` | `{ patient, tests }` · `{ patient, profile }` · `{ report }` + `variant`, `design`, `format` | PDF (default) or HTML |
| `GET /letterhead` | `?format=pdf\|html` | blank stationery |
| `GET /assets/*` | | fonts and images used by the HTML output (cached for a year) |
| `GET /samples` | | demo reports, only with `samples: true` |
| `GET /health` | | `{ ok: true }` |

Errors are JSON `{ "error": "…" }` with `400` (bad input), `404`, `405`, `413` (body too large) or `500`.
`OPTIONS` preflight and `cors` are built in for frontends on another origin.

## Tests and profiles

| Department | Templates |
|---|---|
| **Hematology** | CBC · Haemoglobin · ESR · Blood group · Malaria (card) · BT/CT · PT/INR |
| **Biochemistry** | Blood sugar (F/PP/R) · HbA1c · LFT · RFT · KFT · Electrolytes · Lipid · Iron profile · single tests |
| **Immunoassay** | Thyroid (T3/T4/TSH/FT3/FT4) · Vitamin D · Vitamin B12 · PSA |
| **Serology** | Dengue · HIV/HBsAg/VDRL/HCV · Widal · Typhidot · Malaria antigen · CRP/ASO · RA factor |
| **Clinical pathology** | Urine routine · Urine pregnancy · Stool · Semen analysis |

**Profiles:** Fever · Diabetes · Liver & Kidney · Anaemia · Antenatal · Pre-operative · Full Body Check-up.

A result is either a string (`"10.8"`) or `{ value, flag?, range?, unit?, method? }`. Numeric results are
flagged **H/L** automatically. Use `flag: "abnormal"` for text results such as *Positive*.

## Configuration

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Lab name, address, phone, email, signatory, footer lines | [`src/server/lab.ts`](src/server/lab.ts) (`MGPL_LAB`), or pass `lab` to any function |
| Logo, icons, QC stamp | replace files in [`assets/report-assets/`](assets/report-assets) (SVG or PNG) |
| **Real signature** | **never in git.** Set `MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE` (or `MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE` / `MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE`) to a private image path on the server. The repo ships a placeholder. |
| QR verify link | `verifyBaseUrl` in the lab profile. Without it, the QR holds a plain-text summary. |
| CORS, body limit, demo samples | `createReportApi({ cors, maxBodyBytes, samples })` |

## Printing

| You want | Use | Printer setting |
|---|---|---|
| Pre-printed stationery | `GET /letterhead?format=pdf` | **Borderless**, Actual size |
| Report on plain paper | `variant: "header"` | Actual size |
| Report on stationery | `variant: "non-header"` | Actual size, paper guide snug |

## Project layout

```
src/server/      backend: templates, rendering (HTML + react-pdf), API, adapters
src/shared/      types + API contract
assets/          fonts (OFL), images, licences — shipped in the package
scripts/         smoke test, examples, asset sync
```

## Development

```bash
npm install          # also builds dist/ (prepare)
npm run typecheck
npm run smoke        # 156 renders: every sample × design × variant, HTML + PDF, text verified inside the PDFs
npm run examples     # examples/index.html — HTML + PDF of every sample
```

Read **[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)** before changing layout or templates. It lists the invariants and the
react-pdf pitfalls this project has already hit. Full API: **[docs/api.md](docs/api.md)**. AI index: [llms.txt](llms.txt) · [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

## File: AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit

Instructions for AI coding agents (and humans) working on this repo. Read this before you change anything.

## What this is

The **backend** library (Node.js ≥ 20) that renders A4 pathology reports for MGPL Diagnostics. It has
**two renderers that must look identical**:

1. **HTML**: React components (`src/server/ReportDocument.tsx`, `src/server/sidebar/SidebarReport.tsx`)
2. **PDF**: react-pdf documents (`src/server/pdf/ReportPdf.tsx`, `src/server/sidebar/SidebarReportPdf.tsx`), pure Node.js

They are exposed over HTTP by `createReportApi()`, a standard `(Request) => Response` handler, with
adapters for Fastify (`/fastify` entry) and Express/node:http (`toNodeHandler`).

There are two designs (`sidebar` = Navy Sidebar, the default; `classic` = replica of the lab's old Word
files) and two variants (`header` prints the letterhead; `non-header` omits it for pre-printed paper,
**same positions for everything else**).

**There is no browser code here.** Frontends use `@mgpl-diagnostics/client`, a separate zero-dependency
repo. Do not add browser entry points, hooks or CSS-in-app UI to this package.

## Map

```
src/shared/            types.ts (data model) + api.ts (HTTP contract) — no runtime logic
src/server/index.ts    the package entry ("@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit")
src/server/fastify.ts  the "/fastify" entry (Fastify plugin; fastify is an optional peer)
src/server/
  api.ts               createReportApi: routes, validation, CORS, asset serving, errors
  node.ts              toNodeHandler for Express / node:http
  signatures.ts        real signatures from MGPL_SIGNATURE_* env files (never committed); defaultLab()
  lab.ts               MGPL_LAB branding (placeholder signature)
  templates/           31 test templates + PROFILES + buildReport/buildProfileReport
  format.ts barcode.ts qr.ts samples.ts paths.ts html.ts
  layout.ts measure.ts styles.ts ReportDocument.tsx pdf/      classic design + PDF pipeline
  sidebar/             Navy Sidebar: layout.ts (geometry), measure.ts (pagination), model.ts, styles.ts, renderers
assets/report-assets/  logo.svg, icons, qc-stamp.svg, signature-placeholder.svg, icon licence
assets/report-fonts/   *.woff + LICENSES/ (OFL) — the same files for HTML and PDF
scripts/               sync-assets.mjs, smoke-test.tsx, generate-examples.tsx
dist/                  build output — git-ignored; built by `prepare` and in CI
```

## Commands

```bash
npm run typecheck   # must pass
npm run build       # tsup → dist/ (git-ignored; also runs on install via "prepare")
npm run smoke       # REQUIRED before committing layout/template/renderer changes (~4 min)
npm run examples    # HTML + PDF for every sample → examples/ (git-ignored); look at them
npm run assets      # only when fonts/icons/stamp change
```

## Invariants: do not break these

1. **HTML and PDF must match.** Every position comes from `layout.ts` / `sidebar/layout.ts`, and every
   row height from `measure.ts` / `sidebar/measure.ts`. Never hard-code a size in one renderer only.
   If you add a visual element, add it to *both* renderers and to the layout constants.
2. **Pagination is computed, not measured.** `layoutPages` / `sbLayoutPages` decide page breaks from
   the row-height model. Both renderers set explicit heights from it. If you change a row's content,
   update its height function.
3. **Non-header = header minus letterhead.** Only the letterhead layer (sidebar, header, footer, and
   for classic the logo/address/rule) is conditional. Body, signature, page number: identical positions.
4. **Backend only, but the HTTP contract is shared.** Request/response shapes live in
   `src/shared/api.ts` and are mirrored in `@mgpl-diagnostics/client`; report-studio's
   `contract-check.ts` fails the build if they drift. Change both together.
5. **Components are pure** (no hooks, no `"use client"`), so they work in React Server Components and
   `renderToStaticMarkup`.

## react-pdf gotchas (each one has bitten this project)

- **Text that doesn't fit its box is silently dropped or truncated with "…".** It is not shown as
  overflow like in HTML. Size columns from measured text widths (the smoke test measures every
  string with fontkit) and give fixed-height rows `lineHeight: 1`.
- **A Text after another Text in a flex row can get zero width.** Give rows/cells explicit widths.
- **Missing glyph = crash** (e.g. a non-breaking space U+00A0 or `≥` crashed it). The smoke test
  checks that every printed character exists in the font. Write `>=`, not `≥`. There is no `₹` in
  Manrope, so money uses `Rs.`
- **No SVG images.** SVGs are rasterised with resvg (`svgToPng`) before going into `<Image>`.
- **Leading spaces in a `<Text>` are trimmed.** Put spaces at the end of the previous run.
- Only `.woff`/`.ttf` fonts; they are registered in `src/server/pdf/assets.ts`.

## How to…

**Add a test template**: add it in the right `src/server/templates/*.ts` with `panel({...})` (standard
Test/Result/Unit/Range) or a custom `build()`. Give it `specimen`, `sample` results and (if
needed) `rangeBySex`. Register it in `src/server/templates/index.ts` → `TEMPLATES`, and give it a `category`. Then run `npm run smoke`.
The fit check will tell you if a name/unit/range is too wide for a column.

**Change the Navy Sidebar layout**: edit `src/server/sidebar/layout.ts`. If row content changes, update
`src/server/sidebar/measure.ts`. Run smoke and `npm run examples` and look at the PDFs (render them to PNG to inspect).

**Change branding**: edit `src/server/lab.ts` and/or replace files in `assets/report-assets/`.
The contact email lives only there; update it in one place.

**Signatures**: never commit a real signature image. The package ships `signature-placeholder.svg`;
servers set `MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE` (or `_HEADER_` / `_NONHEADER_`) to a private file, and `defaultLab()`
loads it as a data URI.

**Add an API route**: add it in `src/server/api.ts` (and `ROUTES` in `src/shared/api.ts`), mirror the
types and method in the client repo, and extend invoice-kit's `scripts/api-test.ts`.

**Reference ranges**: the classic templates copy the lab's Word files. Ranges of the newer tests are
standard adult values awaiting the pathologist's sign-off. Don't invent new medical ranges silently;
call them out.

## Testing standard

`npm run smoke` renders 39 samples × 2 designs × 2 variants as HTML **and** PDF, plus the letterhead,
and fails on any of these:
- page-count mismatch;
- a value missing from the HTML **or from the PDF text** (extracted with pdf.js);
- text not fitting its column;
- a missing glyph;
- a missing asset.

Keep it green. When you fix a rendering bug, add a check that would have caught it.

## Privacy and licence

Never commit real patient data or real signatures. The lab's original Word files and the signature
images live outside every repo on purpose. `samples.ts` uses fictional names. The code is "All rights
reserved" (see LICENSE). Bundled fonts and icons keep their own licences (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## File: docs/api.md

# API reference: @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit (v2)

Backend only (Node.js ≥ 20). Positions are inches on A4 (8.27 × 11.69 in); font sizes are pt.
Browsers use [`@mgpl-diagnostics/client`](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client).

Entry points:

| Import | Contents |
|---|---|
| `@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit` | everything below except the Fastify plugin |
| `@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/fastify` | `mgplFastify` plugin (needs `fastify` ≥ 4 installed) |
| `@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/assets/*` | `report-assets/*` images, `report-fonts/*.woff` |

## HTTP API

```ts
createReportApi(opts?: ApiOptions): (req: Request) => Promise<Response>

interface ApiOptions {
  basePath?: string;      // default "/api/mgpl"
  lab?: LabProfile;       // default defaultLab(): MGPL_LAB + MGPL_SIGNATURE_* env files
  samples?: boolean;      // expose GET /samples and { sample } requests (default false)
  cors?: string;          // Access-Control-Allow-Origin, e.g. "https://app.example.com" or "*"
  maxBodyBytes?: number;  // default 1_000_000
  publicUrl?: string;     // public URL of the API behind a proxy (used for asset links in HTML)
}
```

| Route | Notes |
|---|---|
| `GET /health` | `{ ok: true, service: "report-kit" }` |
| `GET /templates` | `TemplateCatalog`: `{ templates: TemplateInfo[], profiles }` |
| `GET /samples` | `SampleInfo[]` (only with `samples: true`, else 404) |
| `POST /report` | body `ReportRequest` → `application/pdf` (default) or `text/html` (`format: "html"`) |
| `GET /letterhead?format=pdf\|html&download=1` | blank stationery |
| `GET /assets/report-assets/<file>` · `/assets/report-fonts/<file>` | immutable, cacheable. HTML output links here. |
| `OPTIONS *` | 204 with CORS headers when `cors` is set |

Errors: JSON `{ error }` with 400 (validation), 404, 405, 413, 500.

```ts
interface ReportRequest {
  patient?: Patient;
  tests?: { template: TemplateId; results: Results }[];
  profile?: { id: ProfileId; results: Partial<Record<TemplateId, Results>> };
  report?: Report;          // an already built report
  sample?: string;          // demo id (samples: true)
  variant?: "header" | "non-header";   // default "header"
  design?: "sidebar" | "classic";      // default "sidebar"
  format?: "pdf" | "html";             // default "pdf"
  fileName?: string; download?: boolean;
}
```

### Mounting

```ts
// Next.js route handler: app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts
const api = createReportApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" });
export { api as GET, api as POST, api as OPTIONS };  export const runtime = "nodejs";

// Fastify
import { mgplFastify } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/fastify";
await app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl", cors: "*" });   // + any ApiOptions, or { handler }

// Express / Koa / node:http (mount before body parsers)
app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createReportApi()));

// Hono / Bun / Deno
app.all("/api/mgpl/*", (c) => api(c.req.raw));
```

Building blocks, for composing your own routes: `templateCatalog()`, `reportFromRequest(body, opts)`,
`labWithAssetUrls(lab, base)`, `serveAsset(path, cors?)`, `apiBaseUrl(req, opts)`, `json()`,
`pdfResponse()`, `htmlResponse()`, `readJson()`, `withCors()`, `HttpError`.

## Building reports

```ts
buildReport(patient: Patient, tests: TestInput[], opts?: { endText?: string }): Report
buildProfileReport(patient, profileId, results: Partial<Record<TemplateId, Results>>): Report

type Results = Record<string, ResultValue | string[] | undefined>
type ResultValue = string | { value?: string; flag?: Flag; range?: string | string[]; unit?: string; method?: string }
type Flag = "auto" | "normal" | "high" | "low" | "abnormal"
```

`TEMPLATES` (by id) and `PROFILES`:

| Category | Template ids |
|---|---|
| Hematology | `cbc` `hb` `esr` `blood-group` `mp` `bt-ct` `pt-inr` |
| Biochemistry | `blood-sugar` `hba1c` `lft` `rft` `kft` `electrolytes` `lipid` `iron-profile` `biochemistry` |
| Immunoassay | `thyroid` `vitamin-d` `vitamin-b12` `psa` |
| Serology | `dengue` `hiv-hbsag-vdrl` `widal` `typhidot` `malaria-antigen` `crp-aso` `ra-factor` |
| Clinical Pathology | `urine` `upt` `stool` `semen` |

Profiles: `fever-profile` `diabetes-profile` `liver-kidney-profile` `anemia-profile` `antenatal-profile`
`pre-operative-profile` `full-body-checkup`.

A `ReportTemplate` has `id`, `name`, `category`, `specimen`, `method`, `fields`, `build(results, { patient })`, `sample`.
"Only filled rows" templates (`blood-sugar`, `thyroid`, `hiv-hbsag-vdrl`, `crp-aso`, `biochemistry`)
print just the tests that have results.

## Rendering

```ts
renderReportPdf({ report, variant, design?, lab?, publicDir?, fontDir? }): Promise<Buffer>
renderLetterheadPdf({ lab?, publicDir?, fontDir? }?): Promise<Buffer>
renderReportHtml({ report, variant, design?, lab?, inline? = true, fontBase?, title? }): Promise<string>
renderLetterheadHtml({ lab?, inline?, fontBase? }?): Promise<string>
inlineLab(lab?, dir?): LabProfile   // /report-assets/* → data URIs
```

React documents (rendered on the server): `LabReport`, `SidebarReport`, `ReportDocument` (classic),
`SidebarLetterhead`, `SbLetterhead`; react-pdf: `SidebarReportPdf`, `ReportPdf`, `SidebarLetterheadPdf`, `SbLetterheadPdf`.
Helpers: `loadImage`, `svgToPng`, `registerFonts`, `assetsDir()`, `packageRoot()`.

## Lab profile and signatures

```ts
interface LabProfile {
  name; logoSrc; addressLines: string[]; email; phone;
  signatory: { name; designation; signatureHeaderSrc; signatureNonHeaderSrc };
  qcStampSrc?; icons: { emailSrc; phoneSrc };
  sidebarText?; footerLines?: string[]; verifyBaseUrl?;
  upiId?; gstin?; registrationNo?; invoiceTerms?: string[];   // used by invoice-kit
}

MGPL_LAB                      // the lab's branding, with a placeholder signature
defaultLab()                  // MGPL_LAB + real signatures from the environment
labFromEnv(lab?, env?)        // reads MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE / _HEADER_FILE / _NONHEADER_FILE
withSignatureFiles(lab, { header?, nonHeader? })
imageFileToDataUri(path)
```

## Other exports

`resolveFlag(row)`, `formatDate`, `formatDateTime`, `formatDoctor`, `fullName`, `barcodeSvg(text, "code39" | "code128")`,
`qrSvg(text)`, `reportQrValue(report, lab)`, `sbLayoutPages`, `layoutPages`, `SIDEBAR_LAYOUT`, `LAYOUT`,
`sidebarCss`, `reportCss`, `SAMPLES`, `getSampleReport(id)`, and all types (`Patient`, `Report`, `Section`, `Row`, …).

## CLI

`npx mgpl-report-assets [dest=public]` copies `report-assets/` and `report-fonts/` into a static folder,
for apps that render the React documents themselves instead of using the API's `/assets` route.

# Third-party notices

`@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit` is © MGPL Diagnostics, all rights reserved (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)).
It bundles or depends on the following third-party work, which stays under its own licence.

## Bundled files

| Files | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `assets/report-fonts/carlito-*.woff` | [Carlito](https://github.com/googlefonts/carlito) via Fontsource | SIL OFL 1.1 — [text](assets/report-fonts/LICENSES/carlito-OFL-1.1.txt) |
| `assets/report-fonts/archivo-black-400.woff` | [Archivo Black](https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/ArchivoBlack) via Fontsource | SIL OFL 1.1 — [text](assets/report-fonts/LICENSES/archivo-black-OFL-1.1.txt) |
| `assets/report-fonts/barlow-semi-condensed-300.woff` | [Barlow](https://github.com/jpt/barlow) via Fontsource | SIL OFL 1.1 — [text](assets/report-fonts/LICENSES/barlow-semi-condensed-OFL-1.1.txt) |
| `assets/report-fonts/manrope-*.woff` | [Manrope](https://github.com/sharanda/manrope) via Fontsource | SIL OFL 1.1 — [text](assets/report-fonts/LICENSES/manrope-OFL-1.1.txt) |
| `assets/report-assets/icon-email.svg`, `icon-phone.svg`, the tick in `qc-stamp.svg` | [Tabler Icons](https://tabler.io/icons) | MIT — [text](assets/report-assets/LICENSE-tabler-icons-MIT.txt) |
| Lettering in `qc-stamp.svg` | outlines of Archivo Black (above) | SIL OFL 1.1 |

[@react-pdf/renderer](https://github.com/diegomura/react-pdf) (MIT), [@resvg/resvg-js](https://github.com/yisibl/resvg-js) (MPL-2.0),

[React](https://react.dev) (MIT).

## File: llms.txt

# @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit

> Backend-only TypeScript library (Node.js >= 20) that renders A4 pathology lab reports for MGPL Diagnostics (Maa Gayatri Path Lab) as PDF (react-pdf, no browser) or HTML, and serves them over an HTTP API that mounts in Next.js route handlers, Fastify (plugin), Express/node:http (adapter), Hono, Bun or Deno. Two designs (`sidebar` Navy Sidebar default, `classic`), two variants (`header`, `non-header` for pre-printed paper), 31 test templates + 7 profiles, automatic H/L flags, barcode + QR. Frontends never import this package; they use @mgpl-diagnostics/client.

Key facts for agents:
- Mount: `createReportApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" })` returns `(Request) => Response`. Fastify: `mgplFastify` from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/fastify". Express: `toNodeHandler(api)`. For reports + invoices use `createMgplApi()` from @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit.
- Routes: GET /templates, POST /report (pdf|html), GET /letterhead, GET /assets/*, GET /samples (opt-in), GET /health. Errors are JSON `{ error }` (400/404/405/413/500).
- In code: `buildReport(patient, [{ template: "cbc", results: { hb: "10.8" } }])` then `renderReportPdf({ report, variant })`. Template ids and their result keys: `TEMPLATES[id].fields` or GET /templates.
- Real signatures are never in git: set MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE (or _HEADER_FILE / _NONHEADER_FILE) on the server; `defaultLab()` loads them. Lab branding (including the contact email) lives only in src/server/lab.ts.
- HTML and PDF share src/server/sidebar/layout.ts + measure.ts; change both renderers together. react-pdf silently drops overflowing text and crashes on missing glyphs (write ">=", "Rs."); run `npm run smoke` after changes.
- dist/ is git-ignored; `prepare` builds it. Licence: all rights reserved.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, mounting in each backend, HTTP API, templates, configuration, printing
- [API reference](docs/api.md): every export, option, route and type
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): architecture, file map, invariants, react-pdf pitfalls, how-tos
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): all of the above plus the key source files in one document

## Source

- [src/server/index.ts](src/server/index.ts): package entry
- [src/server/api.ts](src/server/api.ts): HTTP API
- [src/server/fastify.ts](src/server/fastify.ts): Fastify plugin
- [src/shared/api.ts](src/shared/api.ts): HTTP contract types
- [src/shared/types.ts](src/shared/types.ts): data model
- [src/server/templates/index.ts](src/server/templates/index.ts): TEMPLATES, PROFILES, buildReport

## Optional

- [invoice-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit): invoices + combined API
- [client](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client): frontend SDK
- [report-studio](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-studio): Next.js reference app

## File: scripts/generate-examples.tsx

```tsx
// Generates /examples: standalone HTML + A4 PDF for every sample report, in both designs
// ("sidebar" = Navy Sidebar, "classic" = Word replica) and both variants, plus the blank
// Navy Sidebar letterhead. Open examples/index.html to browse.
//   npm run examples
import { cpSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { LabReport, MGPL_LAB, SidebarLetterhead, type LabProfile, type ReportDesign, type ReportVariant } from "../src/server";
import { renderLetterheadPdf, renderReportPdf } from "../src/server";
import { getSampleReport, SAMPLES } from "../src/server";

const root = process.cwd();
const out = join(root, "examples");
const variants: ReportVariant[] = ["header", "non-header"];
const designs: ReportDesign[] = ["sidebar", "classic"];

// Same lab, but image paths relative to examples/<design>/html/
const rel = (src: string) => (src.startsWith("/") ? "../.." + src : src);
const htmlLab: LabProfile = {
  ...MGPL_LAB,
  logoSrc: rel(MGPL_LAB.logoSrc),
  qcStampSrc: MGPL_LAB.qcStampSrc && rel(MGPL_LAB.qcStampSrc),
  icons: { emailSrc: rel(MGPL_LAB.icons.emailSrc), phoneSrc: rel(MGPL_LAB.icons.phoneSrc) },
  signatory: {
    ...MGPL_LAB.signatory,
    signatureHeaderSrc: rel(MGPL_LAB.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc),
    signatureNonHeaderSrc: rel(MGPL_LAB.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc),
  },
};

const page = (title: string, body: string) => `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>${title}</title>
<style>html,body{margin:0;background:#e8eaee}body{padding:24px 0}@media print{body{padding:0;background:#fff}}</style>
</head><body>${body}</body></html>`;

async function main() {
  rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true });
  for (const d of designs) {
    mkdirSync(join(out, d, "html"), { recursive: true });
    mkdirSync(join(out, d, "pdf"), { recursive: true });
  }
  // Self-contained: copy images + fonts next to the HTML files
  cpSync(join(root, "assets", "report-assets"), join(out, "report-assets"), { recursive: true });
  cpSync(join(root, "assets", "report-fonts"), join(out, "report-fonts"), { recursive: true });

  // Letterhead stationery
  mkdirSync(join(out, "letterhead"), { recursive: true });
  const lhLab = { ...htmlLab, logoSrc: "../report-assets/logo.svg", icons: { emailSrc: "../report-assets/icon-email.svg", phoneSrc: "../report-assets/icon-phone.svg" } };
  writeFileSync(join(out, "letterhead", "letterhead.html"), page("Letterhead", renderToStaticMarkup(<SidebarLetterhead lab={lhLab} fontBase="../report-fonts" />)));
  writeFileSync(join(out, "letterhead", "letterhead.pdf"), await renderLetterheadPdf());
  console.log("letterhead                     html + pdf");

  const rows: string[] = [];
  for (const s of SAMPLES) {
    const report = getSampleReport(s.id)!;
    const cells: string[] = [];
    for (const d of designs) {
      for (const v of variants) {
        const name = `${s.id}-${v}`;
        const markup = renderToStaticMarkup(<LabReport design={d} report={report} variant={v} lab={htmlLab} fontBase="../../report-fonts" />);
        writeFileSync(join(out, d, "html", `${name}.html`), page(`${s.label} — ${d} — ${v}`, markup));
        writeFileSync(join(out, d, "pdf", `${name}.pdf`), await renderReportPdf({ report, variant: v, design: d }));
        cells.push(`<td><a href="${d}/html/${name}.html">HTML</a> · <a href="${d}/pdf/${name}.pdf">PDF</a></td>`);
      }
    }
    console.log(`${s.id.padEnd(30)} 2 designs × 2 variants`);
    rows.push(`<tr><td><b>${s.label}</b><br><small>${s.source}</small></td>${cells.join("")}</tr>`);
  }

  writeFileSync(
    join(out, "index.html"),
    `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>MGPL Report Examples</title>
<style>
body{font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif;margin:0;padding:24px 16px;background:#f5f6f8;color:#1c2230}
h1{color:#14264A;font-size:22px;margin:0 0 4px}p{color:#667085;margin:0 0 16px}
table{border-collapse:collapse;background:#fff;width:100%;max-width:1100px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
th,td{padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e4e7ec;text-align:left;font-size:13px;vertical-align:top}
th{background:#14264A;color:#fff;font-weight:600}small{color:#667085}a{color:#14264A}
.lh{margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px}
</style></head><body>
<h1>MGPL Report Examples</h1><p>${SAMPLES.length} reports × 2 designs × 2 variants. HTML = preview markup, PDF = Node.js render (A4).</p>
<p class="lh"><b>Letterhead stationery</b> (print on blank paper, then use the non-header Navy Sidebar reports):
<a href="letterhead/letterhead.html">HTML</a> · <a href="letterhead/letterhead.pdf">PDF</a></p>
<table><thead><tr><th>Report</th><th>Navy Sidebar · header</th><th>Navy Sidebar · non-header</th><th>Classic · header</th><th>Classic · non-header</th></tr></thead><tbody>
${rows.join("\n")}
</tbody></table></body></html>`,
  );
  console.log(`\nWrote ${SAMPLES.length * 4} HTML + ${SAMPLES.length * 4} PDF files + letterhead to examples/`);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

## File: scripts/llms-full.mjs

````js
// Builds llms-full.txt: every doc and source file of the repo in one plain-text document for AI tools.
//   node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> [file-or-folder …]
// Folders are walked recursively. Output order: README, AGENTS, docs, then the rest alphabetically.
// Skipped: build output, dependencies, lockfiles, generated files, binaries. Files over 150 KB are
// listed (path + size) instead of inlined. CI checks the file is up to date (`npm run llms` + git diff).
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { extname, join, relative } from "node:path";

const [title, ...inputs] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!title || !inputs.length) {
  console.error('usage: node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> …');
  process.exit(1);
}

const TEXT = new Set([".ts", ".tsx", ".mts", ".cts", ".js", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".md", ".mdx", ".json", ".css", ".yml", ".yaml", ".txt", ".graphql", ".gql", ".sql", ".html"]);
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(["node_modules", "dist", ".next", ".git", ".turbo", "coverage", "examples", ".pg-test"]);
const SKIP_FILES = /(^|\/)(package-lock\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|llms-full\.txt|[^/]*\.generated\.[^/]+|[^/]*\.log)$/;
const MAX = 150 * 1024;
const LANG = { ".ts": "ts", ".tsx": "tsx", ".mts": "ts", ".cts": "ts", ".js": "js", ".mjs": "js", ".cjs": "js", ".json": "json", ".css": "css", ".yml": "yaml", ".yaml": "yaml", ".graphql": "graphql", ".gql": "graphql", ".sql": "sql", ".html": "html" };

const posix = (p) => p.split("\\").join("/");
const files = new Set();
function walk(p) {
  const st = statSync(p);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    for (const name of readdirSync(p)) if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(name)) walk(join(p, name));
  } else if (TEXT.has(extname(p).toLowerCase()) && !SKIP_FILES.test(posix(p))) {
    files.add(posix(relative(".", p)));
  }
}
for (const input of inputs) walk(input);

const rank = (f) => (/^README\.md$/i.test(f) ? 0 : /^AGENTS\.md$/i.test(f) ? 1 : /^docs\//.test(f) ? 2 : 3);
const ordered = [...files].sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b) || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));

const parts = [`# ${title} — full documentation and source\n\n> Generated by scripts/llms-full.mjs. Do not edit by hand. ${ordered.length} files.\n\n## Contents\n\n${ordered.map((f) => `- ${f}`).join("\n")}\n`];
const omitted = [];
for (const f of ordered) {
  // LF-normalised text, so Windows and Linux checkouts produce byte-identical output
  const body = readFileSync(f, "utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  const size = Buffer.byteLength(body);
  if (size > MAX) {
    omitted.push(`${f} (${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB)`);
    parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n_Omitted: ${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB. Read the file directly._\n`);
    continue;
  }
  const lang = LANG[extname(f).toLowerCase()];
  const fence = body.includes("```") ? "````" : "```";
  parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n${lang ? `${fence}${lang}\n${body}\n${fence}` : body}\n`);
}
const out = parts.join("");
writeFileSync("llms-full.txt", out);
console.log(`llms-full.txt: ${ordered.length} files, ${(out.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB${omitted.length ? `; omitted (too large): ${omitted.join(", ")}` : ""}`);
````

## File: scripts/smoke-test.tsx

```tsx
// Smoke test — renders every sample report in both designs ("sidebar", "classic") and both
// variants (header / non-header), as HTML and as a Node PDF, plus the blank letterhead, and checks:
//   - nothing throws; files are real PDFs
//   - HTML and PDF have the same number of pages as the shared page layout
//   - every patient field and result value is present in the HTML
//   - the non-header variant never prints the letterhead (logo, sidebar, address)
//   - every printed text fits its column, measured with the real fonts (react-pdf would cut it)
//   - every printed character exists in the font (a missing glyph crashes react-pdf)
//   - every lab asset and font file exists
//   npm run smoke
import { existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import * as fontkit from "fontkit";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import {
  headerCells,
  LabReport,
  layoutPages,
  MGPL_LAB,
  sbLayoutPages,
  SidebarLetterhead,
  SIDEBAR_LAYOUT,
  type Report,
  type ReportDesign,
  type ReportVariant,
  type Rich,
  type Row,
} from "../src/server";
import { renderLetterheadPdf, renderReportPdf } from "../src/server";
import { gridColumns, isTwoColumn, LEGAL, LEGEND, patientFields, sectionMeta, TWO_COL_RESULT_W } from "../src/server/sidebar/model";
import { displayRows, subtitleOf } from "../src/server/sidebar/measure";
import { getSampleReport, SAMPLES } from "../src/server";

const root = process.cwd();
const fontDir = join(root, "assets", "report-fonts");
const open = (f: string) => fontkit.openSync(join(fontDir, f)) as fontkit.Font;
const carlito = { 400: open("carlito-400.woff"), 700: open("carlito-700.woff") };
const manrope = { 400: open("manrope-400.woff"), 600: open("manrope-600.woff"), 700: open("manrope-700.woff"), 800: open("manrope-800.woff") };
type Weight = keyof typeof manrope;

/** inches */
const widthIn = (f: fontkit.Font, text: string, size: number, letterSpacingPt = 0) =>
  ((f.layout(text).advanceWidth / f.unitsPerEm) * size + letterSpacingPt * text.length) / 72;

const problems: string[] = [];
const warn = (m: string) => problems.push(m);
const runs = (r: Rich): { text: string; bold: boolean; size?: number }[] =>
  typeof r === "string" ? [{ text: r, bold: false }] : (Array.isArray(r) ? r : [r]).map((x) => ({ text: x.text, bold: !!x.bold, size: x.size }));

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- glyph coverage */
function checkGlyphs(where: string, text: string, fonts: fontkit.Font[]) {
  for (const ch of new Set(text)) {
    const cp = ch.codePointAt(0)!;
    if (cp < 32) continue;
    if (!fonts.every((f) => f.hasGlyphForCodePoint(cp))) warn(`${where}: character "${ch}" (U+${cp.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(4, "0")}) is missing from the font`);
  }
}
function allText(report: Report): string {
  const out: string[] = patientFields(report).flatMap((f) => [f.label, f.value]);
  for (const s of report.sections) {
    out.push(s.title, s.subtitle ?? "", sectionMeta(s), ...s.columns.map((c) => c.header));
    for (const r of s.rows) {
      if (r.kind === "heading") out.push(r.text);
      if (r.kind === "test") out.push(r.name, r.abbr ?? "", r.result ?? "", r.unit ?? "", ...(Array.isArray(r.range) ? r.range : [r.range ?? ""]), r.method ?? "");
      if (r.kind === "cells") out.push(...r.cells.flatMap(runs).map((x) => x.text));
      if (r.kind === "text") out.push(...runs(r.content).map((x) => x.text));
    }
  }
  return out.join(" ");
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------ fit: classic design */
function fitClassic(id: string, report: Report) {
  const w = (t: string, size: number, bold: boolean, helv: boolean) => widthIn(bold ? carlito[700] : carlito[400], t, size) * (helv ? 1.12 : 1);
  for (const s of report.sections) {
    const st = s.style ?? {};
    const f = st.fontSize ?? 11;
    const helv = /arial|helvetica/i.test(st.font ?? "");
    for (const c of headerCells(s)) {
      const need = w(c.header, 11, true, false);
      const room = c.spanWidth - (c.headerPadLeft ?? 0.08) - 0.08;
      if (need > room + 0.01) warn(`classic ${id}: header "${c.header}" needs ${need.toFixed(2)}in, has ${room.toFixed(2)}in`);
    }
    for (const row of s.rows) {
      if (row.kind !== "test" && row.kind !== "cells") continue;
      s.columns.forEach((c, k) => {
        let lines: { text: string; bold: boolean; size?: number }[][] = [];
        if (row.kind === "cells") lines = [runs(row.cells[k] ?? "")];
        else if (c.key === "name") lines = [[{ text: row.name, bold: !!st.nameBold, size: st.nameSize }, ...(row.abbr ? [{ text: " " + row.abbr, bold: true }] : [])]];
        else if (c.key === "result") lines = [[{ text: row.result ?? "", bold: true, size: st.resultSize }]];
        else if (c.key === "unit") lines = [[{ text: row.unit ?? "", bold: !!st.unitBold }]];
        else if (c.key === "range")
          lines = Array.isArray(row.range) ? row.range.map((l) => [{ text: l, bold: false, size: st.rangeSize ?? 7 }]) : [[{ text: row.range ?? "", bold: !!st.rangeBold }]];
        const need = Math.max(...lines.map((ln) => ln.reduce((a, p) => a + w(p.text, p.size ?? f, p.bold, helv), 0)));
        const room = c.width - (c.padLeft ?? 0) - (k === 0 ? st.indent ?? 0 : 0);
        if (need > room + 0.01) warn(`classic ${id}: "${lines[0].map((p) => p.text).join("")}" needs ${need.toFixed(2)}in, column "${c.key}" has ${room.toFixed(2)}in`);
      });
    }
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------ fit: sidebar design */
function fitSidebar(id: string, report: Report) {
  const { SB_COLS, SB_CELL_PAD, SB_ROWS, SB_PATIENT, SB_CONTENT } = SIDEBAR_LAYOUT;
  const fs = SB_ROWS.fontSize;
  const pad = 2 * SB_CELL_PAD;
  const check = (what: string, need: number, room: number) => {
    if (need > room + 0.005) warn(`sidebar ${id}: ${what} needs ${need.toFixed(2)}in, has ${room.toFixed(2)}in`);
  };
  patientFields(report).forEach((f) =>
    check(`patient "${f.label}" = "${f.value}"`, widthIn(manrope[f.strong ? 800 : 600], f.value, SB_PATIENT.grid.valueSize), SB_PATIENT.grid.colW - 0.08),
  );
  for (const s of report.sections) {
    check(`title "${s.title}"`, widthIn(manrope[800], s.title, 11.5), SB_CONTENT.w);
    const sub = subtitleOf(s);
    if (sub) check(`subtitle "${sub}"`, widthIn(manrope[700], sub, 10), SB_CONTENT.w);
    const grid = s.rows.some((r) => r.kind === "cells");
    if (grid) {
      const { cols, headers } = gridColumns(s);
      headers.forEach((h) => check(`header "${h.header}"`, widthIn(manrope[700], h.header.toUpperCase(), 7, 0.5), h.w - pad));
      for (const r of displayRows(s)) {
        if (r.kind !== "cells") continue;
        cols.forEach((c, k) => {
          const need = runs(r.cells[k] ?? "").reduce((a, p) => a + widthIn(manrope[p.bold ? 800 : 400], p.text, p.size ?? fs), 0);
          check(`cell "${runs(r.cells[k] ?? "").map((p) => p.text).join("")}"`, need, c.w - pad);
        });
      }
      continue;
    }
    const twoCol = isTwoColumn(s);
    for (const r of displayRows(s) as Row[]) {
      if (r.kind !== "test") continue;
      const name = widthIn(manrope[400], r.name, fs) + (r.abbr ? widthIn(manrope[700], " " + r.abbr, fs) : 0);
      check(`name "${r.name}${r.abbr ? " " + r.abbr : ""}"`, name, SB_COLS.name - pad);
      if (r.method) check(`method "${r.method}"`, widthIn(manrope[400], r.method, 6.8), SB_COLS.name - pad);
      if (twoCol) {
        check(`result "${r.result ?? ""}"`, widthIn(manrope[800], r.result ?? "", fs), TWO_COL_RESULT_W - pad);
        continue;
      }
      check(`result "${r.result ?? ""}"`, widthIn(manrope[800], r.result ?? "", fs), SB_COLS.result - pad);
      check(`unit "${r.unit ?? ""}"`, widthIn(manrope[400], r.unit ?? "", fs), SB_COLS.unit - pad);
      for (const line of Array.isArray(r.range) ? r.range : [r.range ?? ""])
        check(`range "${line}"`, widthIn(manrope[400], line, Array.isArray(r.range) ? 7 : fs), SB_COLS.range - pad);
    }
  }
}

function expectedValues(report: Report): string[] {
  const p = report.patient;
  const out = [p.name, String(p.age), p.sex];
  for (const s of report.sections) for (const r of s.rows) if (r.kind === "test" && r.result) out.push(r.result);
  return out.filter(Boolean);
}
const esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
/** All text in a PDF (Mozilla pdf.js), whitespace removed — used to prove values were really drawn. */
async function pdfText(buf: Buffer): Promise<string> {
  const { getDocument } = await import("pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs");
  const task = getDocument({ data: new Uint8Array(buf), disableFontFace: true, verbosity: 0 });
  const doc = await task.promise;
  let out = "";
  for (let p = 1; p <= doc.numPages; p++) {
    const c = await (await doc.getPage(p)).getTextContent();
    out += c.items.map((i) => ("str" in i ? i.str : "")).join("");
  }
  await task.destroy();
  if (out.trim().length < 50) throw new Error("PDF text extraction returned almost nothing");
  return out.replace(/\s+/g, "");
}
const squash = (s: string) => s.replace(/\s+/g, "");
const pdfPageCount = (pdf: Buffer) => (pdf.toString("latin1").match(/\/Type \/Page\b/g) ?? []).length;

async function main() {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  /* assets */
  const lab = MGPL_LAB;
  for (const s of [lab.logoSrc, lab.qcStampSrc!, lab.icons.emailSrc, lab.icons.phoneSrc, lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc, lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc])
    if (!existsSync(join(root, "assets", s))) warn(`missing asset public${s}`);
  for (const f of ["carlito-400.woff", "carlito-700.woff", "carlito-400-italic.woff", "carlito-700-italic.woff", "archivo-black-400.woff", "barlow-semi-condensed-300.woff", ...[400, 500, 600, 700, 800].map((w) => `manrope-${w}.woff`)])
    if (!existsSync(join(fontDir, f))) warn(`missing font ${f}`);

  /* letterhead text + glyphs + fit */
  const lhText = [lab.sidebarText ?? "", ...lab.addressLines, lab.phone, lab.email, ...(lab.footerLines ?? []), LEGEND, LEGAL, lab.signatory.name, lab.signatory.designation].join(" ");
  checkGlyphs("letterhead", lhText, [manrope[400], manrope[800]]);
  (lab.footerLines ?? []).forEach((l, k) =>
    widthIn(manrope[k === 0 ? 700 : 400], l, SIDEBAR_LAYOUT.SB_FOOTER.lines.size) > SIDEBAR_LAYOUT.SB_CONTENT.w && warn(`footer line ${k + 1} is wider than the page content`),
  );

  /* letterhead render */
  try {
    const html = renderToStaticMarkup(<SidebarLetterhead />);
    if (!html.includes("sb-side") || !html.includes(lab.logoSrc)) warn("letterhead HTML is missing the sidebar or logo");
    const pdf = await renderLetterheadPdf();
    if (pdfPageCount(pdf) !== 1) warn("letterhead PDF must be exactly 1 page");
    console.log(`ok   letterhead                                     1 page`);
  } catch (e) {
    warn(`letterhead threw ${(e as Error).stack}`);
  }

  /* reports */
  const designs: ReportDesign[] = ["sidebar", "classic"];
  const variants: ReportVariant[] = ["header", "non-header"];
  let ok = 0;
  for (const sample of SAMPLES) {
    const report = getSampleReport(sample.id)!;
    const text = allText(report);
    checkGlyphs(`sidebar ${sample.id}`, text, [manrope[400], manrope[800]]);
    checkGlyphs(`classic ${sample.id}`, text, [carlito[400], carlito[700]]);
    fitSidebar(sample.id, report);
    fitClassic(sample.id, report);

    for (const d of designs) {
      const pages = d === "sidebar" ? sbLayoutPages(report).length : layoutPages(report).length;
      for (const v of variants) {
        const tag = `${d}/${sample.id}/${v}`;
        try {
          const html = renderToStaticMarkup(<LabReport design={d} report={report} variant={v} />);
          const htmlPages = html.split(d === "sidebar" ? 'class="sb-page"' : 'class="mg-page ').length - 1;
          if (htmlPages !== pages) warn(`${tag}: HTML has ${htmlPages} pages, layout says ${pages}`);
          for (const val of expectedValues(report)) if (!html.includes(esc(val))) warn(`${tag}: HTML is missing "${val}"`);
          const printsLetterhead = html.includes(lab.logoSrc) || html.includes('class="sb-side"') || html.includes(esc(lab.addressLines[0]));
          if (v === "header" && !printsLetterhead) warn(`${tag}: letterhead missing`);
          if (v === "non-header" && printsLetterhead) warn(`${tag}: non-header must not print the letterhead`);

          const pdf = await renderReportPdf({ report, variant: v, design: d });
          if (pdf.subarray(0, 5).toString() !== "%PDF-") warn(`${tag}: not a PDF`);
          if (pdfPageCount(pdf) !== pages) warn(`${tag}: PDF has ${pdfPageCount(pdf)} pages, layout says ${pages}`);
          const text = await pdfText(pdf);
          for (const val of expectedValues(report)) if (!text.includes(squash(val))) warn(`${tag}: PDF is missing "${val}"`);
          ok++;
          console.log(`ok   ${tag.padEnd(46)} ${pages} page(s)  ${(pdf.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`);
        } catch (e) {
          warn(`${tag}: threw ${(e as Error).stack}`);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const total = SAMPLES.length * designs.length * variants.length;
  console.log(`\n${ok}/${total} report renders passed (${SAMPLES.length} samples × 2 designs × 2 variants) + letterhead, in ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s.`);
  if (problems.length) {
    console.log(`\n${problems.length} problem(s):`);
    for (const p of [...new Set(problems)]) console.log("  - " + p);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log("All checks passed.");
}

main();
```

## File: scripts/sync-assets.mjs

```js
// Copies third-party assets from node_modules into ./assets (shipped with the package) so the
// HTML preview and the Node PDF renderer use exactly the same files.
//   - fonts  : @fontsource/*      -> assets/report-fonts/
//   - icons  : @tabler/icons (MIT) -> assets/report-assets/
//   - qc-stamp.svg : circular "QUALITY CONTROL / APPROVED" stamp. Letters are converted to
//                    vector paths with opentype.js, so it renders identically everywhere.
// Run: npm run assets
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import opentype from "opentype.js";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
// resolve packages the way Node does (works standalone and inside an npm workspace)
const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
const nm = (...p) => {
  const pkg = p[0].startsWith("@") ? `${p[0]}/${p[1]}` : p[0];
  const rest = p.slice(p[0].startsWith("@") ? 2 : 1);
  try {
    return join(dirname(require.resolve(`${pkg}/package.json`)), ...rest);
  } catch {
    // packages whose "exports" hide package.json: look in node_modules folders upward
    for (let dir = root; ; dir = dirname(dir)) {
      const cand = join(dir, "node_modules", pkg);
      if (existsSync(cand)) return join(cand, ...rest);
      if (dirname(dir) === dir) throw new Error(`Cannot find ${pkg}`);
    }
  }
};

const fontsDir = join(root, "assets", "report-fonts");
mkdirSync(fontsDir, { recursive: true });
const fonts = [
  ["carlito", "carlito-latin-400-normal.woff", "carlito-400.woff"],
  ["carlito", "carlito-latin-700-normal.woff", "carlito-700.woff"],
  ["carlito", "carlito-latin-400-italic.woff", "carlito-400-italic.woff"],
  ["carlito", "carlito-latin-700-italic.woff", "carlito-700-italic.woff"],
  ["archivo-black", "archivo-black-latin-400-normal.woff", "archivo-black-400.woff"],
  ["barlow-semi-condensed", "barlow-semi-condensed-latin-300-normal.woff", "barlow-semi-condensed-300.woff"],
  // Navy Sidebar design
  ["manrope", "manrope-latin-400-normal.woff", "manrope-400.woff"],
  ["manrope", "manrope-latin-500-normal.woff", "manrope-500.woff"],
  ["manrope", "manrope-latin-600-normal.woff", "manrope-600.woff"],
  ["manrope", "manrope-latin-700-normal.woff", "manrope-700.woff"],
  ["manrope", "manrope-latin-800-normal.woff", "manrope-800.woff"],
];
for (const [pkg, file, out] of fonts) {
  copyFileSync(nm("@fontsource", pkg, "files", file), join(fontsDir, out));
  console.log(`font  ${out}`);
}

// Licence texts travel with the files (the OFL requires it for the fonts)
const licDir = join(fontsDir, "LICENSES");
mkdirSync(licDir, { recursive: true });
for (const pkg of [...new Set(fonts.map((f) => f[0]))]) {
  copyFileSync(nm("@fontsource", pkg, "LICENSE"), join(licDir, `${pkg}-OFL-1.1.txt`));
  console.log(`lic   ${pkg}-OFL-1.1.txt`);
}

// Tabler icons. `color` replaces currentColor (an <img> SVG cannot inherit CSS colour).
const assetsDir = join(root, "assets", "report-assets");
const icons = [
  ["outline/mail-forward.svg", "icon-email.svg", "#000000"],
  ["outline/phone-call.svg", "icon-phone.svg", "#000000"],
];
for (const [src, out, color] of icons) {
  const svg = readFileSync(nm("@tabler", "icons", "icons", src), "utf8")
    .replace(/currentColor/g, color)
    .replace(/\s*class="[^"]*"/, "")
    // explicit size so rasterisers (PDF) get a sharp image
    .replace(/width="24"/, 'width="256"')
    .replace(/height="24"/, 'height="256"');
  writeFileSync(join(assetsDir, out), svg);
  console.log(`icon  ${out}  (tabler ${src})`);
}
copyFileSync(nm("@tabler", "icons", "LICENSE"), join(assetsDir, "LICENSE-tabler-icons-MIT.txt"));

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- QC stamp
const GREEN = "#1E9B3C";
const font = opentype.parse(readFileSync(nm("@fontsource", "archivo-black", "files", "archivo-black-latin-400-normal.woff")).buffer);
const C = 100; // centre of a 200×200 viewBox
const deg = (r) => (r * 180) / Math.PI;

/** Lays `text` along a circle. top=true: reads over the top, letters pointing outward.
 *  top=false: reads along the bottom, letters upright (tops toward the centre). */
function arcText(text, { radius, size, spacing, top }) {
  const glyphs = font.stringToGlyphs(text);
  const scale = size / font.unitsPerEm;
  const widths = glyphs.map((g) => g.advanceWidth * scale + spacing);
  const total = widths.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) - spacing;
  const span = total / radius;
  let x = 0;
  return glyphs
    .map((g, k) => {
      const w = widths[k] - spacing;
      const mid = (x + w / 2) / radius;
      x += widths[k];
      const theta = top ? -Math.PI / 2 - span / 2 + mid : Math.PI / 2 + span / 2 - mid;
      const px = (C + radius * Math.cos(theta)).toFixed(2);
      const py = (C + radius * Math.sin(theta)).toFixed(2);
      const rot = deg(top ? theta + Math.PI / 2 : theta - Math.PI / 2).toFixed(2);
      const d = g.getPath(-w / 2, 0, size).toPathData(2);
      return d ? `<path transform="translate(${px} ${py}) rotate(${rot})" d="${d}"/>` : "";
    })
    .join("");
}

// Tick from Tabler "check" (M5 12l5 5l10 -10), scaled into the centre ring
const tick = readFileSync(nm("@tabler", "icons", "icons", "outline", "check.svg"), "utf8").match(/<path d="([^"]+)"/)[1];

const stamp = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="400" height="400" viewBox="0 0 200 200" role="img" aria-label="Quality Control Approved">
  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="97" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="95" fill="none" stroke="${GREEN}" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="88" fill="none" stroke="${GREEN}" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="58" fill="none" stroke="${GREEN}" stroke-width="3"/>
  <g fill="${GREEN}">
    ${arcText("QUALITY CONTROL", { radius: 67, size: 19, spacing: 1.2, top: true })}
    ${arcText("APPROVED", { radius: 82, size: 19, spacing: 4, top: false })}
    <circle cx="27" cy="117" r="3.6"/>
    <circle cx="173" cy="117" r="3.6"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(100 102) scale(4.3) translate(-12.5 -12)">
    <path d="${tick}" fill="none" stroke="#14692A" stroke-width="3.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="${tick}" fill="none" stroke="#2DBE4E" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
`;
writeFileSync(join(assetsDir, "qc-stamp.svg"), stamp);
console.log("stamp qc-stamp.svg  (opentype.js + tabler check)");
```

import { ReportDocument } from "./ReportDocument";
import { SidebarReport } from "./sidebar/SidebarReport";
import type { LabProfile, Report, ReportDesign, ReportVariant } from "../shared/types";

export interface LabReportProps {
  report: Report;
  variant: ReportVariant;
  /** Default "sidebar" */
  design?: ReportDesign;
  lab?: LabProfile;
  fontBase?: string;
}

/** One entry point for both designs. */
export function LabReport({ design = "sidebar", ...props }: LabReportProps) {
  return design === "classic" ? <ReportDocument {...props} /> : <SidebarReport {...props} />;
}

## File: src/server/ReportDocument.tsx

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from "react";
import { barcodeSvg } from "./barcode";
import { formatDate, formatDoctor, fullName, resolveFlag } from "./format";
import { MGPL_LAB } from "./lab";
import { NON_HEADER, SECTION } from "./layout";
import { headerCells, layoutPages, rowBox, sectionHead } from "./measure";
import { reportCss } from "./styles";
import type { Align, Column, LabProfile, Report, ReportVariant, Rich, Row, Section, TestRow } from "../shared/types";

export interface ReportDocumentProps {
  report: Report;
  variant: ReportVariant;
  /** Lab details and image URLs. Defaults to Maa Gayatri Path Lab. */
  lab?: LabProfile;
  /** Set false if you already injected reportCss() yourself (e.g. several reports on one page). */
  includeStyles?: boolean;
  /** URL folder with the font files from /public/report-fonts. Default "/report-fonts". */
  fontBase?: string;
}

const pt = (n: number) => `${n}pt`;
const inch = (n: number) => `${n}in`;
const justify = (a: Align = "left") => (a === "left" ? "flex-start" : a === "right" ? "flex-end" : "center");

/**
 * A4 lab report (HTML). Pure component (no hooks): works in Server Components,
 * Client Components and renderToStaticMarkup. Pages split exactly like the PDF.
 */
export function ReportDocument({ report, variant, lab = MGPL_LAB, includeStyles = true, fontBase }: ReportDocumentProps) {
  const pages = layoutPages(report);
  const header = variant === "header";
  return (
    <div className="mg-doc">
      {includeStyles && <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: reportCss(fontBase) }} />}
      {pages.map((sections, n) => (
        <div key={n} className={`mg-page ${header ? "mg-header" : "mg-nonheader"}`}>
          {header && <Letterhead lab={lab} />}
          <div className="mg-body">
            <div className="mg-titlebar">LABORATORY TEST REPORT</div>
            <PatientBlock report={report} />
            {sections.map((s, k) => (
              <SectionBlock key={k} section={s} />
            ))}
            {n === pages.length - 1 && <div className="mg-end">{report.endText ?? "--End of Report--"}</div>}
          </div>
          <Footer lab={lab} variant={variant} />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- letterhead */

function Letterhead({ lab }: { lab: LabProfile }) {
  return (
    <>
      <img className="mg-logo" src={lab.logoSrc} alt={lab.name} />
      <div className="mg-divider" />
      <div className="mg-address">
        {lab.addressLines.map((line, k) => (
          <div key={k}>{line}</div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="mg-rule" />
    </>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- patient */

function PatientBlock({ report }: { report: Report }) {
  const p = report.patient;
  return (
    <div className="mg-patient">
      <div className="mg-prow mg-p-name">
        Patient Name: <b>{fullName(p)}</b>
      </div>
      <div className="mg-prow mg-p-date">Sample Collection Date: {formatDate(p.sampleCollectionDate)}</div>
      <div className="mg-prow mg-p-age">
        Age: <b>{p.age}</b> {p.ageUnit ?? "Year(s)"}
      </div>
      {p.patientId && <div className="mg-prow mg-p-id">Patient ID:</div>}
      {p.patientId && <Barcode value={p.patientId} />}
      <div className="mg-prow mg-p-sex">
        Sex: <b>{p.sex}</b>
      </div>
      <div className="mg-prow mg-p-ref">
        Ref. Doctor: <b>{formatDoctor(p.refDoctor)}</b>
      </div>
      <div className="mg-pline" />
    </div>
  );
}

function Barcode({ value }: { value: string }) {
  const svg = barcodeSvg(value);
  if (!svg) return <div className="mg-barcode">{value}</div>;
  return <div className="mg-barcode" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: svg.replace("<svg ", '<svg preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMid meet" ') }} />;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ sections */

function SectionBlock({ section }: { section: Section }) {
  const st = section.style ?? {};
  const { x, w } = section.wide ? SECTION.wide : SECTION.normal;
  const head = sectionHead(section);
  return (
    <div className="mg-section" style={{ marginLeft: inch(x), width: inch(w) }}>
      <div className="mg-sec-head">
        <div
          className="mg-sec-title"
          style={{
            fontSize: pt(st.titleSize ?? 12),
            height: pt(head.title),
            lineHeight: pt(head.title),
            letterSpacing: st.titleSpacing ? pt(st.titleSpacing) : undefined,
          }}
        >
          {section.title}
        </div>
        {!section.hideColumnHeader && (
          <div className="mg-colhead" style={{ height: pt(head.columns) }}>
            {headerCells(section).map((c) => (
              <div
                key={c.key}
                style={{
                  width: inch(c.spanWidth),
                  justifyContent: justify(c.headerAlign ?? c.align),
                  paddingLeft: inch(c.headerPadLeft ?? SECTION.cellPad),
                }}
              >
                {c.header}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="mg-rows" style={{ fontSize: pt(st.fontSize ?? 11), fontFamily: st.font }}>
        {section.rows.map((row, k) => (
          <RowView key={k} row={row} section={section} />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function RowView({ row, section }: { row: Row; section: Section }) {
  const st = section.style ?? {};
  const box = rowBox(row, section);
  const indent = st.indent ?? 0;
  const line: CSSProperties = { height: pt(box.height), marginBottom: pt(box.gap) };

  switch (row.kind) {
    case "heading":
      return (
        <div className="mg-line mg-heading" style={{ ...line, fontSize: pt(row.size ?? st.headingSize ?? 11), color: row.color, paddingLeft: inch(indent) }}>
          {row.text}
        </div>
      );
    case "text":
      return (
        <div className="mg-line" style={{ ...line, paddingLeft: inch(row.indent ?? indent), paddingTop: pt(row.spaceBefore ?? 0) }}>
          <span>
            <RichText value={row.content} />
          </span>
        </div>
      );
    case "cells":
      return (
        <div className="mg-line" style={line}>
          {section.columns.map((c, k) => (
            <Cell key={c.key} c={c} index={k} indent={indent}>
              <RichText value={row.cells[k] ?? ""} />
            </Cell>
          ))}
        </div>
      );
    case "test":
      return <TestRowView row={row} section={section} />;
  }
}

function Cell({ c, index, indent, children }: { c: Column; index: number; indent: number; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="mg-cell"
      style={{ width: inch(c.width), justifyContent: justify(c.align), paddingLeft: inch((c.padLeft ?? 0) + (index === 0 ? indent : 0)) }}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

function TestRowView({ row, section }: { row: TestRow; section: Section }) {
  const st = section.style ?? {};
  const box = rowBox(row, section);
  const indent = st.indent ?? 0;
  const abnormal = resolveFlag(row) !== "normal";

  const content = (c: Column): ReactNode => {
    switch (c.key) {
      case "name":
        return (
          <span style={{ fontWeight: st.nameBold ? 700 : undefined, fontSize: st.nameSize ? pt(st.nameSize) : undefined }}>
            {row.name}
            {row.abbr && <b>{` ${row.abbr}`}</b>}
          </span>
        );
      case "result":
        return (
          <span
            style={{
              color: row.resultColor ?? (abnormal ? st.abnormalColor ?? "#FF0000" : st.resultColor),
              fontWeight: (abnormal && st.abnormalBold !== false) || st.resultBold ? 700 : undefined,
              fontSize: st.resultSize ? pt(st.resultSize) : undefined,
            }}
          >
            {row.result ?? ""}
          </span>
        );
      case "unit":
        return <span style={{ fontWeight: st.unitBold ? 700 : undefined }}>{row.unit ?? ""}</span>;
      case "range":
        if (Array.isArray(row.range)) {
          return (
            <span className="mg-range-lines" style={{ fontSize: pt(st.rangeSize ?? 7), fontFamily: st.rangeFont }}>
              {row.range.map((l, k) => (
                <span key={k}>{l}</span>
              ))}
            </span>
          );
        }
        return <span style={{ fontFamily: st.rangeFont, fontWeight: st.rangeBold ? 700 : undefined }}>{row.range ?? ""}</span>;
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="mg-line" style={{ height: pt(box.height), marginBottom: pt(box.gap) }}>
        {section.columns.map((c, k) => (
          <Cell key={c.key} c={c} index={k} indent={indent}>
            {content(c)}
          </Cell>
        ))}
      </div>
      {box.method && (
        <div
          className="mg-line mg-method"
          style={{
            height: pt(box.method.height),
            marginTop: pt(box.method.gapTop),
            marginBottom: pt(box.method.gap),
            fontSize: pt(box.method.size),
            paddingLeft: inch(indent),
          }}
        >
          {row.method}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- footer */

/** Same positions in both variants; only the signature image (and optionally contacts) differ. */
function Footer({ lab, variant }: { lab: LabProfile; variant: ReportVariant }) {
  const header = variant === "header";
  const src = header ? lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc : lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc;
  return (
    <>
      {(header || !NON_HEADER.hideContactFooter) && (
        <>
          <img className="mg-f-email-icon" src={lab.icons.emailSrc} alt="" />
          <div className="mg-f-text mg-f-email">
            Email: <span>{lab.email}</span>
          </div>
          <img className="mg-f-phone-icon" src={lab.icons.phoneSrc} alt="" />
          <div className="mg-f-text mg-f-phone">
            Mobile No: <span>{lab.phone}</span>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {lab.qcStampSrc && <img className="mg-f-qc" src={lab.qcStampSrc} alt="Quality Control Approved" />}
      <img className="mg-f-sign" src={src} alt="Signature" />
      <div className="mg-f-signatory">
        <div>{lab.signatory.name}</div>
        <div>{lab.signatory.designation}</div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- rich */

function RichText({ value }: { value: Rich }) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return <>{value}</>;
  const runs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
  return (
    <>
      {runs.map((r, k) => (
        <span
          key={k}
          style={{
            fontWeight: r.bold ? 700 : undefined,
            fontStyle: r.italic ? "italic" : undefined,
            color: r.color,
            fontSize: r.size ? pt(r.size) : undefined,
            fontFamily: r.font,
          }}
        >
          {r.text}
        </span>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## File: src/server/api.ts

```ts
// Backend HTTP API for the report kit, built on the standard Fetch `Request`/`Response`, so it runs
// unchanged in Next.js route handlers, Hono, Bun, Deno — and in Express / node:http via toNodeHandler().
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { DEFAULT_BASE_PATH, ROUTES, type ReportRequest, type SampleInfo, type TemplateCatalog } from "../shared/api";
import type { LabProfile, Report } from "../shared/types";
import { renderLetterheadHtml, renderReportHtml } from "./html";
import { defaultLab } from "./signatures";
import { assetsDir } from "./paths";
import { renderLetterheadPdf, renderReportPdf } from "./pdf";
import { getSampleReport, SAMPLES } from "./samples";
import { buildProfileReport, buildReport, PROFILES, TEMPLATES, type ProfileId, type TemplateId } from "./templates";

export type ApiHandler = (req: Request) => Promise<Response>;

export interface ApiOptions {
  /** Where the handler is mounted (default "/api/mgpl") */
  basePath?: string;
  /** Lab branding (default: MGPL_LAB + private signatures from MGPL_SIGNATURE_* env vars) */
  lab?: LabProfile;
  /** Expose demo samples: GET /samples and `{ sample: id }` requests (default false) */
  samples?: boolean;
  /** Access-Control-Allow-Origin for browser clients on another origin, e.g. "https://app.example.com" or "*" */
  cors?: string;
  /** Max JSON body size in bytes (default 1 MB) */
  maxBodyBytes?: number;
  /** Public URL of this API when behind a proxy (default: taken from the request) */
  publicUrl?: string;
}

export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers */

export function json(body: unknown, status = 200, headers: HeadersInit = {}): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8", ...headers } });
}

export function pdfResponse(pdf: Buffer, fileName: string, download: boolean): Response {
  return new Response(new Uint8Array(pdf), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/pdf",
      "Content-Disposition": `${download ? "attachment" : "inline"}; filename="${fileName.replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, "_")}"`,
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
    },
  });
}

export function htmlResponse(html: string): Response {
  return new Response(html, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
}

export async function readJson<T>(req: Request, maxBytes: number): Promise<T> {
  const len = Number(req.headers.get("content-length") ?? 0);
  if (len > maxBytes) throw new HttpError(413, `Body larger than ${maxBytes} bytes`);
  const text = await req.text();
  if (text.length > maxBytes) throw new HttpError(413, `Body larger than ${maxBytes} bytes`);
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text || "{}") as T;
  } catch {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Body must be JSON");
  }
}

/** The public URL prefix of this API, e.g. "https://lab.example.com/api/mgpl" */
export function apiBaseUrl(req: Request, opts: ApiOptions): string {
  const base = (opts.basePath ?? DEFAULT_BASE_PATH).replace(/\/$/, "");
  return (opts.publicUrl ?? new URL(req.url).origin + base).replace(/\/$/, "");
}

/** Lab profile whose "/report-assets/…" images point at this API's GET /assets route. */
export function labWithAssetUrls(lab: LabProfile, assetBase: string): LabProfile {
  const u = (src: string) => (src.startsWith("/report-assets/") ? `${assetBase}${src}` : src);
  return {
    ...lab,
    logoSrc: u(lab.logoSrc),
    qcStampSrc: lab.qcStampSrc && u(lab.qcStampSrc),
    icons: { emailSrc: u(lab.icons.emailSrc), phoneSrc: u(lab.icons.phoneSrc) },
    signatory: { ...lab.signatory, signatureHeaderSrc: u(lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc), signatureNonHeaderSrc: u(lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc) },
  };
}

const ASSET_TYPES: Record<string, string> = { svg: "image/svg+xml", png: "image/png", jpg: "image/jpeg", jpeg: "image/jpeg", woff: "font/woff" };

/** GET /assets/report-assets/<file> | /assets/report-fonts/<file> — the package's bundled files. */
export async function serveAsset(rel: string, cors?: string): Promise<Response> {
  const m = rel.match(/^\/(report-assets|report-fonts)\/([\w.-]+)$/);
  const type = m && ASSET_TYPES[m[2].split(".").pop()!.toLowerCase()];
  if (!m || !type) return json({ error: "Not found" }, 404);
  try {
    const data = await readFile(join(assetsDir(), m[1], m[2]));
    return new Response(new Uint8Array(data), {
      headers: { "Content-Type": type, "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=31536000, immutable", ...(cors ? { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": cors } : {}) },
    });
  } catch {
    return json({ error: "Not found" }, 404);
  }
}

export function withCors(res: Response, cors?: string): Response {
  if (!cors) return res;
  const h = new Headers(res.headers);
  h.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", cors);
  h.set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS");
  h.set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization");
  h.set("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", "Content-Disposition");
  if (cors !== "*") h.append("Vary", "Origin");
  return new Response(res.body, { status: res.status, headers: h });
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- report API */

export function templateCatalog(): TemplateCatalog {
  return {
    templates: (Object.keys(TEMPLATES) as TemplateId[]).map((id) => {
      const t = TEMPLATES[id];
      return { id, name: t.name, category: t.category, specimen: t.specimen, method: t.method, fields: t.fields };
    }),
    profiles: (Object.keys(PROFILES) as ProfileId[]).map((id) => ({ id, name: PROFILES[id].name, tests: PROFILES[id].tests })),
  };
}

/** Turns a ReportRequest into a Report (throws HttpError 400 on bad input). */
export function reportFromRequest(body: ReportRequest, opts: Pick<ApiOptions, "samples"> = {}): Report {
  try {
    if (body.report) {
      if (!body.report.patient?.name || !Array.isArray(body.report.sections)) throw new Error("report needs patient.name and sections[]");
      return body.report;
    }
    if (body.sample) {
      if (!opts.samples) throw new Error("samples are disabled on this server");
      const r = getSampleReport(body.sample);
      if (!r) throw new Error(`unknown sample "${body.sample}"`);
      return r;
    }
    if (!body.patient?.name || body.patient.age == null || !body.patient.sex) throw new Error("patient needs name, age and sex");
    if (body.profile) return buildProfileReport(body.patient, body.profile.id, body.profile.results ?? {});
    if (Array.isArray(body.tests) && body.tests.length) return buildReport(body.patient, body.tests);
    throw new Error("send tests[], profile, report or sample");
  } catch (e) {
    throw new HttpError(400, (e as Error).message);
  }
}

/**
 * The report backend. Mount it at `basePath`:
 *
 *   // Next.js: app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts
 *   const api = createReportApi();
 *   export const GET = api, POST = api, OPTIONS = api;  export const runtime = "nodejs";
 *
 *   // Express / node:http
 *   app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createReportApi()));
 */
export function createReportApi(opts: ApiOptions = {}): ApiHandler {
  const base = (opts.basePath ?? DEFAULT_BASE_PATH).replace(/\/$/, "");
  const lab = opts.lab ?? defaultLab();
  const max = opts.maxBodyBytes ?? 1_000_000;

  return async (req) => {
    if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return withCors(new Response(null, { status: 204 }), opts.cors);
    let path = new URL(req.url).pathname;
    if (path.startsWith(base)) path = path.slice(base.length) || "/";
    try {
      const res = await route(req, path);
      return withCors(res, opts.cors);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof HttpError) return withCors(json({ error: e.message }, e.status), opts.cors);
      console.error("[@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit]", e);
      return withCors(json({ error: "Internal error" }, 500), opts.cors);
    }
  };

  async function route(req: Request, path: string): Promise<Response> {
    const get = req.method === "GET" || req.method === "HEAD";
    const q = new URL(req.url).searchParams;

    if (path.startsWith(ROUTES.assets + "/") && get) return serveAsset(path.slice(ROUTES.assets.length), opts.cors);
    if (path === ROUTES.health && get) return json({ ok: true, service: "report-kit" });
    if (path === ROUTES.templates && get) return json(templateCatalog());
    if (path === ROUTES.samples && get) {
      if (!opts.samples) throw new HttpError(404, "samples are disabled on this server");
      return json(SAMPLES.map((s): SampleInfo => ({ id: s.id, label: s.label, group: s.group, source: s.source })));
    }
    if (path === ROUTES.letterhead && get) {
      if (q.get("format") === "html") {
        const assetBase = apiBaseUrl(req, opts) + ROUTES.assets;
        return htmlResponse(await renderLetterheadHtml({ lab: labWithAssetUrls(lab, assetBase), inline: false, fontBase: `${assetBase}/report-fonts` }));
      }
      return pdfResponse(await renderLetterheadPdf({ lab }), "letterhead.pdf", q.get("download") === "1");
    }
    if (path === ROUTES.report) {
      if (req.method !== "POST") throw new HttpError(405, "Use POST");
      const body = await readJson<ReportRequest>(req, max);
      const report = reportFromRequest(body, opts);
      const variant = body.variant === "non-header" ? "non-header" : "header";
      const design = body.design === "classic" ? "classic" : "sidebar";
      if (body.format === "html") {
        const assetBase = apiBaseUrl(req, opts) + ROUTES.assets;
        return htmlResponse(
          await renderReportHtml({ report, variant, design, lab: labWithAssetUrls(lab, assetBase), inline: false, fontBase: `${assetBase}/report-fonts` }),
        );
      }
      const pdf = await renderReportPdf({ report, variant, design, lab });
      return pdfResponse(pdf, body.fileName ?? `${report.patient.patientId ?? "report"}-${variant}.pdf`, !!body.download);
    }
    throw new HttpError(404, `No route ${req.method} ${path}`);
  }
}
```

## File: src/server/barcode.ts

```ts
// "generic" build: no canvas/Node deps, so the same code runs in the browser and in Node.
import { toSVG } from "bwip-js/generic";

/**
 * Scannable barcode (Code 39 by default, Code 128 for long values) with the human-readable text, as an SVG string,
 * generated by bwip-js. Used by the HTML preview (inline) and the PDF (rasterised).
 * Returns null when the text can't be encoded (Code 39 = A–Z, 0–9, space - . $ / + %).
 */
export function barcodeSvg(text: string, symbology: "code39" | "code128" = "code39"): string | null {
  try {
    return toSVG({
      bcid: symbology,
      text: symbology === "code39" ? text.toUpperCase() : text,
      height: 11, // bar height, mm (sets the aspect ratio; display size comes from layout.ts)
      includetext: true,
      textxalign: "center",
      textsize: 10,
      textgaps: 3,
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

## File: src/server/fastify.ts

```ts
// Fastify plugin for any Fetch-style ApiHandler (report-kit, invoice-kit, or both combined).
import type { FastifyPluginAsync, FastifyReply, FastifyRequest } from "fastify";
import { createReportApi, type ApiHandler, type ApiOptions } from "./api";

export interface FastifyMgplOptions extends ApiOptions {
  /** Use your own handler (e.g. invoice-kit's createMgplApi). Default: createReportApi(options). */
  handler?: ApiHandler;
}

/** Bridges one Fastify request/reply to a Fetch-style handler. */
export async function handleWithFetch(handler: ApiHandler, request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply): Promise<FastifyReply> {
  const proto = request.protocol ?? "http";
  const url = `${proto}://${request.headers.host ?? "localhost"}${request.raw.url ?? request.url}`;
  const headers = new Headers();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(request.headers)) if (v !== undefined) headers.set(k, Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(", ") : String(v));
  const hasBody = request.method !== "GET" && request.method !== "HEAD" && request.body != null;
  const body = hasBody ? (typeof request.body === "string" || Buffer.isBuffer(request.body) ? request.body : JSON.stringify(request.body)) : undefined;
  const res = await handler(new Request(url, { method: request.method, headers, body: body as BodyInit | undefined }));
  reply.code(res.status);
  res.headers.forEach((v, k) => reply.header(k, v));
  return reply.send(Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer()));
}

/**
 * Fastify plugin — registers every MGPL route under its prefix:
 *
 *   import Fastify from "fastify";
 *   import { mgplFastify } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/server";
 *   const app = Fastify();
 *   await app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl", cors: "https://app.example.com" });
 *   await app.listen({ port: 4000 });
 *
 * The plugin is encapsulated: its raw JSON body parser does not affect your other routes.
 */
export const mgplFastify: FastifyPluginAsync<FastifyMgplOptions> = async (fastify, options) => {
  const basePath = options.basePath ?? (fastify.prefix || "/api/mgpl");
  const handler = options.handler ?? createReportApi({ ...options, basePath });
  // keep the JSON body as a string — the handler parses and size-checks it itself
  fastify.removeContentTypeParser("application/json");
  fastify.addContentTypeParser("application/json", { parseAs: "string", bodyLimit: options.maxBodyBytes ?? 1_000_000 }, (_req, body, done) => done(null, body));
  fastify.all("/*", (request, reply) => handleWithFetch(handler, request, reply));
  fastify.all("/", (request, reply) => handleWithFetch(handler, request, reply));
};
```
