## File: src/server/format.ts

```ts
import type { Flag, Patient, Section, TestRow } from "../shared/types";

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

/** DD-MM-YYYY, like the original reports. Strings are printed as-is. */
export function formatDate(value: Date | string | undefined): string {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value;
  const d = value ?? new Date();
  return `${pad(d.getDate())}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

/** DD-MM-YYYY hh:mm AM/PM. Strings are printed as-is. */
export function formatDateTime(value: Date | string | undefined): string {
  if (value === undefined) return "";
  if (typeof value === "string") return value;
  const h = value.getHours();
  return `${formatDate(value)} ${pad(h % 12 || 12)}:${pad(value.getMinutes())} ${h < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"}`;
}

export function formatDoctor(ref: string | undefined): string {
  const v = (ref ?? "Self").trim();
  return /^dr\b/i.test(v) ? v : `Dr. ${v}`;
}

const num = (s: string) => {
  const m = s.replace(/,/g, "").match(/-?\d+(\.\d+)?/);
  return m ? parseFloat(m[0]) : NaN;
};

/**
 * Works out whether a result is outside its reference range.
 * Understands "12.0 - 15.0", "9.0 – 17.0", "<20", "< 1.0", ">40", "<1 - 2".
 * Non-numeric results (Nil, Negative…) are treated as normal unless flagged.
 */
export function resolveFlag(row: TestRow): Exclude<Flag, "auto"> {
  if (row.flag && row.flag !== "auto") return row.flag;
  const result = row.result?.trim();
  const range = Array.isArray(row.range) ? undefined : row.range?.trim();
  if (!result || !range) return "normal";
  const value = num(result);
  if (Number.isNaN(value) || !/^\s*-?\d/.test(result)) return "normal";

  const between = range.match(/^<?\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[-–—]\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
  if (between) {
    const lo = parseFloat(between[1]);
    const hi = parseFloat(between[2]);
    if (value < lo) return "low";
    if (value > hi) return "high";
    return "normal";
  }
  const lt = range.match(/^<\s*=?\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/);
  if (lt) return value >= parseFloat(lt[1]) ? "high" : "normal";
  const gt = range.match(/^>\s*=?\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/);
  if (gt) return value <= parseFloat(gt[1]) ? "low" : "normal";
  return "normal";
}

export const fullName = (p: Patient) => [p.title, p.name].filter(Boolean).join(" ");

/** Splits sections into A4 pages at `pageBreakBefore`. */
export function paginate(sections: Section[]): Section[][] {
  const pages: Section[][] = [[]];
  for (const s of sections) {
    if (s.pageBreakBefore && pages[pages.length - 1].length) pages.push([]);
    pages[pages.length - 1].push(s);
  }
  return pages;
}
```

## File: src/server/html.ts

```ts
// Server-side helpers (Node.js): render a report to a complete HTML document string.
// With `inline: true` every font and image is embedded as a data URI, so the HTML works anywhere
// (emails, file archives, backends without a static folder).
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { extname, join } from "node:path";
import { createElement } from "react";
import { defaultLab } from "./signatures";
import { LabReport } from "./LabReport";
import { assetsDir } from "./paths";
import { SidebarLetterhead } from "./sidebar/SidebarReport";
import type { LabProfile, Report, ReportDesign, ReportVariant } from "../shared/types";

export { assetsDir, packageRoot } from "./paths";

const MIME: Record<string, string> = { ".svg": "image/svg+xml", ".png": "image/png", ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpeg": "image/jpeg", ".woff": "font/woff" };
const FONT_BASE = "__MGPL_FONTS__";

function dataUri(file: string): string {
  return `data:${MIME[extname(file).toLowerCase()] ?? "application/octet-stream"};base64,${readFileSync(file).toString("base64")}`;
}

/** Lab profile with every "/report-assets/…" path replaced by a data URI from the package assets. */
export function inlineLab(lab: LabProfile = defaultLab(), dir = assetsDir()): LabProfile {
  const conv = (src: string) => (src.startsWith("/") ? dataUri(join(dir, src)) : src);
  return {
    ...lab,
    logoSrc: conv(lab.logoSrc),
    qcStampSrc: lab.qcStampSrc && conv(lab.qcStampSrc),
    icons: { emailSrc: conv(lab.icons.emailSrc), phoneSrc: conv(lab.icons.phoneSrc) },
    signatory: {
      ...lab.signatory,
      signatureHeaderSrc: conv(lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc),
      signatureNonHeaderSrc: conv(lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc),
    },
  };
}

function inlineFonts(html: string, dir = assetsDir()): string {
  return html.replace(new RegExp(`${FONT_BASE}/([\\w.-]+\\.woff)`, "g"), (_, f: string) => dataUri(join(dir, "report-fonts", f)));
}

export interface RenderHtmlOptions {
  report: Report;
  variant: ReportVariant;
  design?: ReportDesign;
  lab?: LabProfile;
  /** Embed fonts and images (default true). When false, assets load from `fontBase` and the lab's URLs. */
  inline?: boolean;
  /** URL folder of report-fonts when inline is false (default "/report-fonts") */
  fontBase?: string;
  title?: string;
}

const wrap = (title: string, body: string) =>
  `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>${title}</title>` +
  `<style>html,body{margin:0;background:#e8eaee}body{padding:24px 0}@media print{body{padding:0;background:#fff}}</style></head><body>${body}</body></html>`;

/** Full HTML document for a report. */
export async function renderReportHtml(opts: RenderHtmlOptions): Promise<string> {
  const { renderToStaticMarkup } = await import("react-dom/server");
  const inline = opts.inline !== false;
  const lab = inline ? inlineLab(opts.lab) : opts.lab ?? defaultLab();
  const body = renderToStaticMarkup(
    createElement(LabReport, { report: opts.report, variant: opts.variant, design: opts.design, lab, fontBase: inline ? FONT_BASE : opts.fontBase }),
  );
  const html = wrap(opts.title ?? `${opts.report.patient.name} - Lab Report`, body);
  return inline ? inlineFonts(html) : html;
}

/** Full HTML document of the blank Navy Sidebar letterhead. */
export async function renderLetterheadHtml(opts: { lab?: LabProfile; inline?: boolean; fontBase?: string } = {}): Promise<string> {
  const { renderToStaticMarkup } = await import("react-dom/server");
  const inline = opts.inline !== false;
  const lab = inline ? inlineLab(opts.lab) : opts.lab ?? defaultLab();
  const body = renderToStaticMarkup(createElement(SidebarLetterhead, { lab, fontBase: inline ? FONT_BASE : opts.fontBase }));
  const html = wrap(`${lab.name} - Letterhead`, body);
  return inline ? inlineFonts(html) : html;
}
```

## File: src/server/index.ts

```ts
// @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/server — BACKEND ONLY (Node.js ≥ 20).
// Everything that builds and renders reports lives here: templates, React document components,
// PDF (react-pdf), HTML strings and the HTTP API. Browsers use "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/client".

// HTTP API — mount in any backend
export {
  createReportApi,
  templateCatalog,
  reportFromRequest,
  labWithAssetUrls,
  serveAsset,
  apiBaseUrl,
  json,
  pdfResponse,
  htmlResponse,
  readJson,
  withCors,
  HttpError,
  type ApiHandler,
  type ApiOptions,
} from "./api";
export { toNodeHandler } from "./node";

// Rendering
export { renderReportPdf, renderLetterheadPdf, type RenderPdfOptions } from "./pdf";
export { ReportPdf, SbLetterheadPdf, SidebarLetterheadPdf, SidebarReportPdf, type SbPdfImages } from "./pdf";
export { loadImage, registerFonts, svgToPng } from "./pdf";
export { renderReportHtml, renderLetterheadHtml, inlineLab, type RenderHtmlOptions } from "./html";
export { assetsDir, packageRoot } from "./paths";
export { defaultLab, labFromEnv, withSignatureFiles, imageFileToDataUri } from "./signatures";

// Documents (React components rendered on the server)
export { LabReport, type LabReportProps } from "./LabReport";
export { ReportDocument, type ReportDocumentProps } from "./ReportDocument";
export { SbLetterhead, SidebarLetterhead, SidebarReport, type SidebarReportProps } from "./sidebar/SidebarReport";
export { sidebarCss } from "./sidebar/styles";
export { sbLayoutPages, sbRowHeight } from "./sidebar/measure";
```

```ts
/**
 * Single source of truth for the report geometry, shared by the HTML preview (styles.ts)
 * and the Node PDF renderer (pdf/ReportPdf.tsx). Measured from the original Word designs.
 *
 * Positions/sizes are in inches from the page's top-left corner; font sizes in pt.
 * A4 = 8.27in × 11.69in.
 */
export const PAGE = { w: 8.27, h: 11.69 };

export const COLORS = {
  navy: "#162884",
  band: "#BDD6EE",
  blue: "#00B0F0",
  red: "#FF0000",
  divider: "#A6A6A6",
  patientLine: "#808080",
  email: "#5F6368",
  phone: "#767171",
};

/** Font families. HTML and PDF load the same files from /public/report-fonts. */

  title: "Archivo Black", // stands in for Arial Black

};

export const LETTERHEAD = {

export const BODY_TOP = 1.59;

export const TITLE_BAR = { x: 0.41, w: 7.38, h: 0.19, size: 11 };

/** Patient block: every field uses the same font size. */
export const PATIENT = {
  height: 1.42,
  size: 12,
  lineHeight: 0.22,
  name: { x: 0.5, y: 0.01 },
  age: { x: 0.5, y: 0.36 },
```

## File: src/server/measure.ts

```ts
/**
 * Row heights + page splitting, shared by the HTML preview and the PDF renderer.
 * Both renderers give every row exactly the height computed here, so the preview,
 * the printed page and the PDF always break pages at the same place.
 * All values are in pt (1in = 72pt).
 */
import { BODY_TOP, END, PATIENT, SECTION, TITLE_BAR } from "./layout";
import type { Column, Report, Rich, Row, Section } from "../shared/types";

export const LINE = 1.22; // Calibri / Carlito single line spacing
const IN = 72;

/** Lowest point (inches from page top) the body may reach before the signature area. */
export const CONTENT_BOTTOM = 9.85;

export interface RowBox {
  /** Height of the main line(s), pt */
  height: number;
  /** Space after the main line(s), pt */
  gap: number;
  /** Italic method line under a test */
  method?: { gapTop: number; height: number; gap: number; size: number };
}

const richSizes = (r: Rich): number[] =>
  typeof r === "string" ? [] : (Array.isArray(r) ? r : [r]).map((x) => x.size ?? 0);

export function rowBox(row: Row, section: Section): RowBox {
  const st = section.style ?? {};
  const f = st.fontSize ?? 11;
  const gap = st.rowGap ?? 6;
  switch (row.kind) {
    case "heading":
      return { height: (row.size ?? st.headingSize ?? 11) * LINE, gap: st.headingGap ?? gap };
    case "text":
      return { height: (row.spaceBefore ?? 0) + Math.max(f, ...richSizes(row.content)) * LINE, gap };
    case "cells":
      return { height: Math.max(f, ...row.cells.flatMap(richSizes)) * LINE, gap };
    case "test": {
      let h = Math.max(f, st.nameSize ?? 0, st.resultSize ?? 0) * LINE;
      if (Array.isArray(row.range)) h = Math.max(h, row.range.length * (st.rangeSize ?? 7) * 1.2);
      if (st.rowHeight) h = Math.max(h, st.rowHeight);
      if (!row.method) return { height: h, gap };
      const size = st.methodSize ?? f;
      return { height: h, gap: 0, method: { gapTop: st.methodGap ?? 6, height: size * LINE, gap, size } };
    }
  }
}

export const rowTotal = (b: RowBox) => b.height + b.gap + (b.method ? b.method.gapTop + b.method.height + b.method.gap : 0);

/** Blue band: title line + optional column-header line, pt */
export function sectionHead(section: Section) {
  const title = (section.style?.titleSize ?? 12) * 1.3;
  const columns = section.hideColumnHeader ? 0 : SECTION.colHeader.lineHeight * IN;
  return { title, columns, total: title + columns + SECTION.border * 3 };
}

/** Column-header cells with `headerSpan` merged (width = sum of spanned columns). */
export function headerCells(section: Section): (Column & { spanWidth: number })[] {
  const out: (Column & { spanWidth: number })[] = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < section.columns.length; ) {
    const c = section.columns[k];
    const span = Math.max(1, c.headerSpan ?? 1);
    const spanWidth = section.columns.slice(k, k + span).reduce((a, x) => a + x.width, 0);
    out.push({ ...c, spanWidth });
    k += span;
  }
  return out;
}

export const END_HEIGHT = END.marginTop * IN + END.size * LINE;

/** Space for sections on one page, pt */
export function pageCapacity() {
  return (CONTENT_BOTTOM - BODY_TOP - TITLE_BAR.h - PATIENT.height) * IN;
}

/**
 * Splits the report into A4 pages. Sections that do not fit continue on the next page
 * (the blue band is repeated). Honours `section.pageBreakBefore`; keeps sub-headings
 * with the row below them; keeps "--End of Report--" with the last row.
 */
export function layoutPages(report: Report): Section[][] {
  const capacity = pageCapacity();
  const gapAfter = SECTION.gapAfter * IN;
  const pages: Section[][] = [[]];
  let used = 0;
  const newPage = () => {
    pages.push([]);
    used = 0;
  };

  report.sections.forEach((section, si) => {
    const lastSection = si === report.sections.length - 1;
    if (section.pageBreakBefore && pages[pages.length - 1].length) newPage();
    const head = sectionHead(section).total;
    const heights = section.rows.map((r) => rowTotal(rowBox(r, section)));
    // what must sit together with row i: a heading needs the next row as well
    const need = (i: number) => {
      let h = heights[i];
      if (section.rows[i].kind === "heading" && i + 1 < heights.length) h += heights[i + 1];
      if (lastSection && i === heights.length - 1) h += END_HEIGHT;
      return h;
    };

    let part: Row[] = [];
    const flush = () => {
      if (part.length || !section.rows.length) pages[pages.length - 1].push({ ...section, rows: part, pageBreakBefore: false });
      part = [];
    };

    if (!section.rows.length) {
      if (used + head > capacity && used > 0) newPage();
      flush();
      used += head + gapAfter;
      return;
    }
    if (used > 0 && used + head + need(0) > capacity) newPage();
    used += head;
    section.rows.forEach((row, i) => {
      if (part.length && used + need(i) > capacity) {
        flush();
        newPage();
        used = head;
      }
      part.push(row);
      used += heights[i];
    });
    flush();
    used += gapAfter;
  });
  return pages;
}
```

## File: src/server/node.ts

```ts
// Adapter: run a Fetch-style ApiHandler inside Express, Fastify (raw), Koa or node:http.
import type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from "node:http";
import type { ApiHandler } from "./api";

/**
 *   import express from "express";
 *   app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createReportApi()));   // mount BEFORE express.json()
 *
 *   import { createServer } from "node:http";
 *   createServer(toNodeHandler(createReportApi())).listen(4000);
 */
export function toNodeHandler(handler: ApiHandler) {
  return async (req: IncomingMessage & { originalUrl?: string }, res: ServerResponse, next?: (err?: unknown) => void) => {
    try {
      const fwd = req.headers["x-forwarded-proto"];
      const proto = (Array.isArray(fwd) ? fwd[0] : fwd)?.split(",")[0] ?? ("encrypted" in req.socket && req.socket.encrypted ? "https" : "http");
      const url = `${proto}://${req.headers.host ?? "localhost"}${req.originalUrl ?? req.url ?? "/"}`;
      const headers = new Headers();
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(req.headers)) if (v !== undefined) headers.set(k, Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(", ") : v);
      let body: Buffer | undefined;
      if (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD") {
        const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
        for await (const c of req) chunks.push(c as Buffer);
        body = Buffer.concat(chunks);
      }
      const response = await handler(new Request(url, { method: req.method, headers, body: body ? new Uint8Array(body) : undefined }));
      res.statusCode = response.status;
      response.headers.forEach((v, k) => res.setHeader(k, v));
      res.end(Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer()));
    } catch (e) {
      if (next) next(e);
      else {
        res.statusCode = 500;
        res.end("Internal error");
      }
    }
  };
}
```

## File: src/server/paths.ts

```ts
// Node-only: where this package's bundled assets live on disk (works from src/ and dist/, any chunk depth).
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

let root: string | undefined;

/** Absolute path of the @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit package folder. */
export function packageRoot(): string {
  if (root) return root;
  let dir = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const pkg = join(dir, "package.json");
    if (existsSync(pkg) && JSON.parse(readFileSync(pkg, "utf8")).name === "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit") return (root = dir);
    dir = dirname(dir);
  }
  throw new Error("@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit: cannot locate the package folder");
}

/** Folder holding report-assets/ (images) and report-fonts/ (woff). Use as `publicDir` for PDFs. */
export const assetsDir = () => join(packageRoot(), "assets");
```

## File: src/server/pdf/ReportPdf.tsx

```tsx
import { Document, Image, Page, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { formatDate, formatDoctor, fullName, resolveFlag } from "../format";
import {
  BODY_TOP,
  COLORS,
  END,
  FONTS,
  FOOTER_HEADER as FH,
  LETTERHEAD as LH,
  NON_HEADER,
  PATIENT as P,
  SECTION,
  TITLE_BAR as TB,
} from "../layout";
import { LINE, headerCells, layoutPages, rowBox, sectionHead } from "../measure";
import type { Align, Column, LabProfile, Report, ReportVariant, Rich, Row, Section, TestRow } from "../../shared/types";
import type { PdfImage } from "./assets";

/** Lab images already loaded as buffers (see renderReportPdf). */
export interface PdfLabImages {
  logo: PdfImage;
  email: PdfImage;
  phone: PdfImage;
  qc?: PdfImage;
  signature: PdfImage;
  /** Patient-ID barcode (bwip-js SVG, rasterised) */
  barcode?: PdfImage;
}

const i = (n: number) => `${n}in`;
/** line-height multiplier from an absolute height in inches */
const lh = (inches: number, pt: number) => (inches * 72) / pt;
const justify = (a: Align = "left") => (a === "left" ? "flex-start" : a === "right" ? "flex-end" : "center");
/** Map the CSS font stacks used by templates to PDF fonts */
const pdfFont = (css?: string) => (!css ? undefined : /arial|helvetica|verdana/i.test(css) ? "Helvetica" : FONTS.body);

/** Same geometry and page breaks as <ReportDocument/>, drawn with react-pdf (pure Node.js). */
export function ReportPdf(props: { report: Report; variant: ReportVariant; lab: LabProfile; images: PdfLabImages }) {
  const { report, variant, lab, images } = props;
  const pages = layoutPages(report);
  const header = variant === "header";
  return (
    <Document title={`${fullName(report.patient)} - Lab Report`} author={lab.name} creator={lab.name} producer={lab.name}>
      {pages.map((sections, n) => (
        <Page key={n} size="A4" style={{ fontFamily: FONTS.body, fontSize: 11, color: "#000" }}>
          {header && <Letterhead lab={lab} images={images} />}
          <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, right: 0, top: i(BODY_TOP) }}>
            <View
              style={{
                marginLeft: i(TB.x),
                width: i(TB.w),
                height: i(TB.h),
                backgroundColor: COLORS.navy,
                borderWidth: 0.5,
                borderColor: "#000",
                justifyContent: "center",
              }}
            >
              <Text style={{ color: "#fff", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: TB.size, textAlign: "center", lineHeight: 1 }}>LABORATORY TEST REPORT</Text>
            </View>
            <PatientBlock report={report} barcode={images.barcode} />
            {sections.map((s, k) => (
              <SectionBlock key={k} section={s} />
            ))}
            {n === pages.length - 1 && (
              <Text style={{ textAlign: "center", fontSize: END.size, lineHeight: LINE, marginTop: i(END.marginTop) }}>
                {report.endText ?? "--End of Report--"}
              </Text>
            )}
          </View>
          <Footer lab={lab} images={images} header={header} />
        </Page>
      ))}
    </Document>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- letterhead */

function Letterhead({ lab, images }: { lab: LabProfile; images: PdfLabImages }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Image
        src={images.logo}
        style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(LH.logo.x), top: i(LH.logo.y), width: i(LH.logo.w), height: i(LH.logo.h), objectFit: "contain", objectPositionX: 0 }}
      />
      <View
        style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(LH.divider.x), top: i(LH.divider.y), height: i(LH.divider.h), borderLeftWidth: LH.divider.width, borderLeftColor: COLORS.divider }}
      />
      <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(LH.address.x), top: i(LH.address.y) }}>
        {lab.addressLines.map((line, k) => (
          <Text key={k} style={{ fontFamily: FONTS.address, fontWeight: 300, fontSize: LH.address.size, lineHeight: lh(LH.address.lineHeight, LH.address.size) }}>
            {line}
          </Text>
        ))}
      </View>
      <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, right: 0, top: i(LH.rule.y), borderTopWidth: LH.rule.width, borderTopColor: "#000" }} />
    </>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- patient */

/** One patient line. Explicit width so the flex children are never squeezed. */
const prow = (pos: { x: number; y: number }) =>
  ({ position: "absolute", left: i(pos.x), top: i(pos.y), width: i(3.6), height: i(P.lineHeight), flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" }) as const;

function PatientBlock({ report, barcode }: { report: Report; barcode?: PdfImage }) {
  const p = report.patient;
  const t = { fontSize: P.size, lineHeight: 1 } as const;
  const b = { ...t, fontWeight: 700 } as const;
  return (
    <View style={{ position: "relative", height: i(P.height) }}>
      <View style={prow(P.name)}>
        <Text style={t}>Patient Name: </Text>
        <Text style={b}>{fullName(p)}</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={prow(P.date)}>
        <Text style={t}>Sample Collection Date: {formatDate(p.sampleCollectionDate)}</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={prow(P.age)}>
        <Text style={t}>Age: </Text>
        <Text style={b}>{`${p.age} `}</Text>
        <Text style={t}>{p.ageUnit ?? "Year(s)"}</Text>
      </View>
      {p.patientId && (
        <View style={prow(P.id)}>
          <Text style={t}>{barcode ? "Patient ID:" : "Patient ID: "}</Text>
          {!barcode && <Text style={b}>{p.patientId}</Text>}
        </View>
      )}
      {barcode && (
        <Image
          src={barcode}
          style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(P.barcode.x), top: i(P.barcode.y), width: i(P.barcode.w), height: i(P.barcode.h), objectFit: "contain", objectPositionX: 0 }}
        />
      )}
      <View style={prow(P.sex)}>
        <Text style={t}>Sex: </Text>
        <Text style={b}>{p.sex}</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={prow(P.ref)}>
        <Text style={t}>Ref. Doctor: </Text>
        <Text style={b}>{formatDoctor(p.refDoctor)}</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(P.line.x), width: i(P.line.w), top: i(P.line.y), borderTopWidth: P.line.width, borderTopColor: COLORS.patientLine }} />
    </View>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ sections */

function SectionBlock({ section }: { section: Section }) {
  const st = section.style ?? {};
  const { x, w } = section.wide ? SECTION.wide : SECTION.normal;
  const head = sectionHead(section);
  const f = st.fontSize ?? 11;
  return (
    <View style={{ marginLeft: i(x), width: i(w), marginBottom: i(SECTION.gapAfter) }}>
      <View style={{ backgroundColor: COLORS.band, borderWidth: SECTION.border, borderColor: "#000" }}>
        <View style={{ height: head.title, justifyContent: "center" }}>
          <Text style={{ fontFamily: FONTS.title, fontSize: st.titleSize ?? 12, textAlign: "center", lineHeight: 1, letterSpacing: st.titleSpacing }}>
            {section.title}
          </Text>
        </View>
        {!section.hideColumnHeader && (
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", borderTopWidth: SECTION.border, borderTopColor: "#000", height: head.columns }}>
            {headerCells(section).map((c) => (
              <View
                key={c.key}
                style={{
                  width: i(c.spanWidth),
                  paddingLeft: i(c.headerPadLeft ?? SECTION.cellPad),
                  paddingRight: i(SECTION.cellPad),
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: justify(c.headerAlign ?? c.align),
                }}
              >
                <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: SECTION.colHeader.size, lineHeight: 1 }}>{c.header}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
      <View style={{ fontSize: f, fontFamily: pdfFont(st.font) }}>
        {section.rows.map((row, k) => (
          <RowView key={k} row={row} section={section} />
        ))}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function RowView({ row, section }: { row: Row; section: Section }) {
  const st = section.style ?? {};
  const box = rowBox(row, section);
  const indent = st.indent ?? 0;
  const f = st.fontSize ?? 11;
  const line = { height: box.height, marginBottom: box.gap, flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" } as const;

  switch (row.kind) {
    case "heading":
      return (
        <View style={{ ...line, paddingLeft: i(indent) }}>
          <Text style={{ fontFamily: FONTS.body, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: row.size ?? st.headingSize ?? 11, color: row.color, lineHeight: 1 }}>{row.text}</Text>
        </View>
      );
    case "text":
      return (
        <View style={{ ...line, paddingLeft: i(row.indent ?? indent), paddingTop: row.spaceBefore ?? 0 }}>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: f, lineHeight: 1 }}>
            <RichText value={row.content} />
          </Text>
        </View>
      );
    case "cells":
      return (
        <View style={line}>
          {section.columns.map((c, k) => (
            <Cell key={c.key} c={c} index={k} indent={indent}>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: f, lineHeight: 1 }}>
                <RichText value={row.cells[k] ?? ""} />
              </Text>
            </Cell>
          ))}
        </View>
      );
    case "test":
      return <TestRowView row={row} section={section} />;
  }
}

function Cell({ c, index, indent, children }: { c: Column; index: number; indent: number; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: i(c.width),
        height: "100%",
        paddingLeft: i((c.padLeft ?? 0) + (index === 0 ? indent : 0)),
        flexDirection: "row",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: justify(c.align),
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

function TestRowView({ row, section }: { row: TestRow; section: Section }) {
  const st = section.style ?? {};
  const box = rowBox(row, section);
  const indent = st.indent ?? 0;
  const f = st.fontSize ?? 11;
  const abnormal = resolveFlag(row) !== "normal";

  const content = (c: Column): ReactNode => {
    switch (c.key) {
      case "name":
        return (
          <Text style={{ fontSize: st.nameSize ?? f, fontWeight: st.nameBold ? 700 : 400, lineHeight: 1 }}>
            {row.name}
            {row.abbr && <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{` ${row.abbr}`}</Text>}
          </Text>
        );
      case "result":
        return (
          <Text
            style={{
              fontSize: st.resultSize ?? f,
              lineHeight: 1,
              color: row.resultColor ?? (abnormal ? st.abnormalColor ?? COLORS.red : st.resultColor ?? "#000"),
              fontWeight: (abnormal && st.abnormalBold !== false) || st.resultBold ? 700 : 400,
            }}
          >
            {row.result ?? ""}
          </Text>
        );
      case "unit":
        return <Text style={{ fontSize: f, lineHeight: 1, fontWeight: st.unitBold ? 700 : 400 }}>{row.unit ?? ""}</Text>;
      case "range":
        if (Array.isArray(row.range)) {
          return (
            <View>
              {row.range.map((l, k) => (
                <Text key={k} style={{ fontSize: st.rangeSize ?? 7, lineHeight: 1.2, fontFamily: pdfFont(st.rangeFont) }}>
                  {l}
                </Text>
              ))}
            </View>
          );
        }
        return (
          <Text style={{ fontSize: f, lineHeight: 1, fontWeight: st.rangeBold ? 700 : 400, fontFamily: pdfFont(st.rangeFont) }}>{row.range ?? ""}</Text>
        );
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <View>
      <View style={{ height: box.height, marginBottom: box.gap, flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" }}>
        {section.columns.map((c, k) => (
          <Cell key={c.key} c={c} index={k} indent={indent}>
            {content(c)}
          </Cell>
        ))}
      </View>
      {box.method && (
        <View
          style={{
            height: box.method.height,
            marginTop: box.method.gapTop,
            marginBottom: box.method.gap,
            paddingLeft: i(indent),
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
          }}
        >
          <Text style={{ fontStyle: "italic", fontWeight: 400, fontSize: box.method.size, lineHeight: 1 }}>{row.method}</Text>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- footer */

const abs = (b: { x: number; y: number; w?: number; h?: number; s?: number }) =>
  ({ position: "absolute", left: i(b.x), top: i(b.y), width: i(b.w ?? b.s!), height: i(b.h ?? b.s!), objectFit: "contain" }) as const;

/** Same positions in both variants; only the signature image (and optionally contacts) differ. */
function Footer({ lab, images, header }: { lab: LabProfile; images: PdfLabImages; header: boolean }) {
  const text = (pos: { x: number; y: number }) =>
    ({ position: "absolute", left: i(pos.x), top: i(pos.y), fontWeight: 700, fontSize: FH.size, lineHeight: lh(FH.lineHeight, FH.size) }) as const;
  const s = { fontWeight: 700, fontSize: FH.size, lineHeight: lh(FH.lineHeight, FH.size), textAlign: "center" } as const;
  return (
    <>
      {(header || !NON_HEADER.hideContactFooter) && (
        <>
          <Image src={images.email} style={abs(FH.emailIcon)} />
          <Text style={text(FH.email)}>
            Email: <Text style={{ color: COLORS.email }}>{lab.email}</Text>
          </Text>
          <Image src={images.phone} style={abs(FH.phoneIcon)} />
          <Text style={text(FH.phone)}>
            Mobile No: <Text style={{ color: COLORS.phone }}>{lab.phone}</Text>
          </Text>
        </>
      )}
      {images.qc && <Image src={images.qc} style={abs(FH.qc)} />}
      <Image src={images.signature} style={abs(FH.sign)} />
      <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(FH.signatory.x), width: i(FH.signatory.w), top: i(FH.signatory.y) }}>
        <Text style={s}>{lab.signatory.name}</Text>
        <Text style={s}>{lab.signatory.designation}</Text>
      </View>
    </>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- rich */

function RichText({ value }: { value: Rich }) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return <>{value}</>;
  const runs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
  return (
    <>
      {runs.map((r, k) => (
        <Text
          key={k}
          style={{
            fontWeight: r.bold ? 700 : 400,
            fontStyle: r.italic ? "italic" : "normal",
            color: r.color,
            fontSize: r.size,
            fontFamily: pdfFont(r.font),
          }}
        >
          {r.text}
        </Text>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## File: src/server/pdf/assets.ts

```ts
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { extname, join } from "node:path";
import { Resvg } from "@resvg/resvg-js";
import { Font } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import { FONTS } from "../layout";
import { SB_FONT } from "../sidebar/layout";

/** Image ready for react-pdf's <Image src={...}> */
export interface PdfImage {
  data: Buffer;
  format: "png" | "jpg";
}

const cache = new Map<string, Promise<PdfImage>>();

/**
 * Loads an image for the PDF. Accepts the same `src` strings as the HTML preview:
 *   "/report-assets/logo.svg"  -> read from `publicDir`
 *   "https://…"                -> fetched
 *   "data:image/svg+xml;base64,…"
 * SVGs are rasterised with resvg (react-pdf cannot embed SVG files).
 */
export function loadImage(src: string, publicDir: string): Promise<PdfImage> {
  const key = `${publicDir}|${src}`;
  let p = cache.get(key);
  if (!p) {
    p = load(src, publicDir);
    cache.set(key, p);
    p.catch(() => cache.delete(key));
  }
  return p;
}

async function load(src: string, publicDir: string): Promise<PdfImage> {
  let data: Buffer;
  let kind: string;

  if (src.startsWith("data:")) {
    const m = src.match(/^data:([^;,]+)(;base64)?,(.*)$/s);
    if (!m) throw new Error("Bad data URI");
    data = m[2] ? Buffer.from(m[3], "base64") : Buffer.from(decodeURIComponent(m[3]));
    kind = m[1];
  } else if (/^https?:\/\//.test(src)) {
    const res = await fetch(src);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Image ${src}: HTTP ${res.status}`);
    data = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
    kind = res.headers.get("content-type") ?? extname(new URL(src).pathname);
  } else {
    const path = join(publicDir, decodeURI(src.split("?")[0]));
    data = await readFile(path);
    kind = extname(path);
  }

  if (/svg/i.test(kind)) return svgToPng(data);
  if (/jpe?g/i.test(kind)) return { data, format: "jpg" };
  return { data, format: "png" };
}

/** Rasterises an SVG for react-pdf (which cannot embed SVG files). 1600px wide ≈ 500+ dpi on the page. */
export function svgToPng(svg: string | Buffer, width = 1600): PdfImage {
  const png = new Resvg(svg, { fitTo: { mode: "width", value: width }, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0)" }).render().asPng();
  return { data: Buffer.from(png), format: "png" };
}

let registeredFrom: string | null = null;

/** Registers the report fonts (same .woff files the HTML preview uses). */
export function registerFonts(fontDir: string) {
  if (registeredFrom === fontDir) return;
  const f = (file: string) => join(fontDir, file);
  Font.register({
    family: FONTS.body,
    fonts: [
      { src: f("carlito-400.woff"), fontWeight: 400 },
      { src: f("carlito-700.woff"), fontWeight: 700 },
      { src: f("carlito-400-italic.woff"), fontWeight: 400, fontStyle: "italic" },
      { src: f("carlito-700-italic.woff"), fontWeight: 700, fontStyle: "italic" },
    ],
  });
  Font.register({ family: FONTS.title, src: f("archivo-black-400.woff") });
  Font.register({ family: FONTS.address, src: f("barlow-semi-condensed-300.woff"), fontWeight: 300 });
  // Navy Sidebar design
  Font.register({
    family: SB_FONT,
    fonts: [400, 500, 600, 700, 800].map((w) => ({ src: f(`manrope-${w}.woff`), fontWeight: w })),
  });
  // Never hyphenate medical terms
  Font.registerHyphenationCallback((word) => [word]);
  registeredFrom = fontDir;
}
```

## File: src/server/pdf/index.ts

```ts
// Server-side (Node.js) PDF export — no browser involved.
// Import from "@/report-kit/pdf" only in route handlers / server actions / scripts.
import { join } from "node:path";
import { renderToBuffer } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import { createElement, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { barcodeSvg } from "../barcode";
import { defaultLab } from "../signatures";
import { qrSvg, reportQrValue } from "../qr";
import { SidebarLetterheadPdf, SidebarReportPdf } from "../sidebar/SidebarReportPdf";
import type { LabProfile, Report, ReportDesign, ReportVariant } from "../../shared/types";
import { assetsDir } from "../paths";
import { loadImage, registerFonts, svgToPng } from "./assets";
import { ReportPdf } from "./ReportPdf";

export { ReportPdf } from "./ReportPdf";
export { SbLetterheadPdf, SidebarLetterheadPdf, SidebarReportPdf, type SbPdfImages } from "../sidebar/SidebarReportPdf";
export { loadImage, registerFonts, svgToPng } from "./assets";
export { assetsDir, packageRoot } from "../paths";

export interface RenderPdfOptions {
  report: Report;
  variant: ReportVariant;
  /** "sidebar" (Navy Sidebar, default) or "classic" (replica of the Word designs) */
  design?: ReportDesign;
  lab?: LabProfile;
  /** Folder that "/report-assets/…" image paths resolve against. Default: this package's assets/ */
  publicDir?: string;
  /** Folder with the report .woff fonts. Default: <publicDir>/report-fonts */
  fontDir?: string;
}

const render = (el: ReactElement) => renderToBuffer(el as Parameters<typeof renderToBuffer>[0]);

function setup(opts: { lab?: LabProfile; publicDir?: string; fontDir?: string }) {
  const lab = opts.lab ?? defaultLab();
  const publicDir = opts.publicDir ?? assetsDir();
  registerFonts(opts.fontDir ?? join(publicDir, "report-fonts"));
  return { lab, publicDir };
}

/** Renders a report to an A4 PDF (Buffer) in pure Node.js. */
export async function renderReportPdf(opts: RenderPdfOptions): Promise<Buffer> {
  const { lab, publicDir } = setup(opts);
  const header = opts.variant === "header";
  const [logo, email, phone, qc, signature] = await Promise.all([
    loadImage(lab.logoSrc, publicDir),
    loadImage(lab.icons.emailSrc, publicDir),
    loadImage(lab.icons.phoneSrc, publicDir),
    lab.qcStampSrc ? loadImage(lab.qcStampSrc, publicDir) : undefined,
    loadImage(header ? lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc : lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc, publicDir),
  ]);
  const id = opts.report.patient.patientId;
  const bar = id ? barcodeSvg(id) : null;
  const barcode = bar ? svgToPng(bar) : undefined;

  if ((opts.design ?? "sidebar") === "classic") {
    const images = { logo, email, phone, qc, signature, barcode };
    return render(createElement(ReportPdf, { report: opts.report, variant: opts.variant, lab, images }));
  }
  const qr = svgToPng(qrSvg(reportQrValue(opts.report, lab)), 800);
  const images = { logo, email, phone, qc, signature, barcode, qr };
  return render(createElement(SidebarReportPdf, { report: opts.report, variant: opts.variant, lab, images }));
}

/** Blank A4 letterhead (Navy Sidebar: sidebar + header + footer) for printing pre-printed paper. */
export async function renderLetterheadPdf(opts: { lab?: LabProfile; publicDir?: string; fontDir?: string } = {}): Promise<Buffer> {
  const { lab, publicDir } = setup(opts);
  const [logo, email, phone] = await Promise.all([
    loadImage(lab.logoSrc, publicDir),
    loadImage(lab.icons.emailSrc, publicDir),
    loadImage(lab.icons.phoneSrc, publicDir),
  ]);
  return render(createElement(SidebarLetterheadPdf, { lab, images: { logo, email, phone } }));
}
```

## File: src/server/qr.ts

```ts
import QRCode from "qrcode";
import { fullName, formatDate } from "./format";
import type { LabProfile, Report } from "../shared/types";

/** QR code as an SVG string (encoded by the `qrcode` library; synchronous, works in browser and Node). */
export function qrSvg(text: string, color = "#000"): string {
  const qr = QRCode.create(text, { errorCorrectionLevel: "M" });
  const n = qr.modules.size;
  // one rectangle per horizontal run of dark modules keeps the SVG small
  let d = "";
  for (let y = 0; y < n; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < n; ) {
      if (!qr.modules.get(y, x)) {
        x++;
        continue;
      }
      let run = 1;
      while (x + run < n && qr.modules.get(y, x + run)) run++;
      d += `M${x} ${y}h${run}v1h-${run}z`;
      x += run;
    }
  }
  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${n} ${n}" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><path fill="${color}" d="${d}"/></svg>`;
}

/** What the report's QR code encodes: a verify URL when the lab has one, else a text summary. */
export function reportQrValue(report: Report, lab: LabProfile): string {
  if (report.qrValue) return report.qrValue;
  const p = report.patient;
  const id = p.sampleId ?? p.patientId;
  if (lab.verifyBaseUrl && id) return `${lab.verifyBaseUrl}${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
  return [
    lab.name,
    `Patient: ${fullName(p)}`,
    `Age/Sex: ${p.age} / ${p.sex}`,
    p.patientId && `Patient ID: ${p.patientId}`,
    p.sampleId && `Sample ID: ${p.sampleId}`,
    `Date: ${formatDate(p.sampleCollectionDate)}`,
    `Tests: ${[...new Set(report.sections.map((s) => s.subtitle ?? s.title))].join(", ")}`,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join("\n");
}
```

```ts
const DEMO_FEMALE: Patient = { title: "Mrs", name: "Sunita Devi Patel", age: 38, sex: "Female", patientId: "MGPL1025", refDoctor: "Self", sampleCollectionDate: "12-10-2026" };
const NEW_TEMPLATES: TemplateId[] = [
  "rft", "kft", "electrolytes", "hba1c", "iron-profile", "biochemistry", "thyroid", "vitamin-d", "vitamin-b12", "psa",
  "esr", "bt-ct", "pt-inr", "typhidot", "malaria-antigen", "crp-aso",
];
const FEMALE_FIRST = new Set<TemplateId>(["iron-profile", "thyroid", "vitamin-b12"]);

export const SAMPLES: Sample[] = [
  ...DESIGN_SAMPLES.map((s) => ({ ...s, group: "design" as const })),
  ...NEW_TEMPLATES.map((id) => ({
    id,
    group: "template" as const,
    label: TEMPLATES[id].name,
    source: "New template",
    patient: FEMALE_FIRST.has(id) ? DEMO_FEMALE : DEMO_MALE,
    tests: [withSample(id)],
  })),
  ...(Object.keys(PROFILES) as ProfileId[]).map((id) => ({
    id,
    group: "profile" as const,
    label: PROFILES[id].name,
    source: `Profile: ${PROFILES[id].tests.join(", ")}`,
    patient: id === "antenatal-profile" || id === "anemia-profile" ? DEMO_FEMALE : DEMO_MALE,
    tests: PROFILES[id].tests.map(withSample),
  })),
];

/** Demo sample metadata derived from the collection date (DD-MM-YYYY). */
function withSampleMeta(p: Patient): Patient {
  const date = typeof p.sampleCollectionDate === "string" ? p.sampleCollectionDate : "12-10-2026";
  const [d, m, y] = date.split("-");
  return {
    sampleId: `S${y?.slice(2)}${m}${d}${(p.patientId ?? "0").replace(/\D/g, "").padStart(4, "0")}`,
    collectedAt: `${date} 08:45 AM`,
    registeredAt: `${date} 09:02 AM`,
    reportedAt: `${date} 01:30 PM`,
    ...p,
  };
}

export function getSampleReport(id: string): Report | undefined {
  const s = SAMPLES.find((x) => x.id === id);
  return s && buildReport(withSampleMeta(s.patient), s.tests);
}
```

## File: src/server/sidebar/SidebarReport.tsx

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { barcodeSvg } from "../barcode";
import { MGPL_LAB } from "../lab";
import { qrSvg, reportQrValue } from "../qr";
import type { Align, LabProfile, Report, ReportVariant, Rich, Row, Section, TestRow } from "../../shared/types";
import { SB_CELL_PAD, SB_COLS } from "./layout";
import { isGrid, sbLayoutPages, sbRowHeight, showsTableHeader, subtitleOf, type SbPart } from "./measure";
import { flagOf, gridColumns, isTwoColumn, LEGAL, LEGEND, patientFields, sectionMeta, STD_COLUMNS, TWO_COL_RESULT_W } from "./model";
import { sidebarCss } from "./styles";

export interface SidebarReportProps {
  report: Report;
  /** "header" prints the letterhead (sidebar, header, footer); "non-header" leaves it to the pre-printed paper. */
  variant: ReportVariant;
  lab?: LabProfile;
  includeStyles?: boolean;
  /** URL folder with the font files from /public/report-fonts */
  fontBase?: string;
}

const pt = (n: number) => `${n}pt`;
const inch = (n: number) => `${n}in`;
const al = (a: Align = "left") => (a === "left" ? "l" : a === "right" ? "r" : "c");
const Svg = ({ className, svg }: { className: string; svg: string }) => <div className={className} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: svg }} />;

/** Navy Sidebar report (HTML). Pure component — Server/Client Components and renderToStaticMarkup. */
export function SidebarReport({ report, variant, lab = MGPL_LAB, includeStyles = true, fontBase }: SidebarReportProps) {
  const pages = sbLayoutPages(report);
  const bar = report.patient.patientId ? barcodeSvg(report.patient.patientId) : null;
  const qr = qrSvg(reportQrValue(report, lab));
  const signature = variant === "header" ? lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc : lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc;
  return (
    <div className="sb-doc">
      {includeStyles && <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: sidebarCss(fontBase) }} />}
      {pages.map((page, n) => (
        <div key={n} className="sb-page">
          {variant === "header" && <SbLetterhead lab={lab} />}
          <PatientBlock report={report} />
          {bar && <Svg className="sb-barcode" svg={bar} />}
          <Svg className="sb-qr" svg={qr} />
          <div className="sb-qr-label">Scan to verify</div>
          <div className="sb-body">
            {page.parts.map((part, k) => (
              <SectionPart key={k} part={part} />
            ))}
            {page.isLast && (
              <div className="sb-end">
                <div className="sb-legend">{LEGEND}</div>
                <div className="sb-endtext">— {(report.endText ?? "End of Report").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")} —</div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {lab.qcStampSrc && <img className="sb-qc" src={lab.qcStampSrc} alt="Quality Control Approved" />}
          <img className="sb-signimg" src={signature} alt="Signature" />
          <div className="sb-signname">
            <b>{lab.signatory.name}</b>
            <span>{lab.signatory.designation}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="sb-legal">
            <span>{LEGAL}</span>
            <span>
              Page {n + 1} of {pages.length}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Blank A4 letterhead (sidebar + header + footer only) — print this to make pre-printed paper. */
export function SidebarLetterhead({ lab = MGPL_LAB, includeStyles = true, fontBase }: { lab?: LabProfile; includeStyles?: boolean; fontBase?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="sb-doc">
      {includeStyles && <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: sidebarCss(fontBase) }} />}
      <div className="sb-page">
        <SbLetterhead lab={lab} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- letterhead */

/** Letterhead layer (sidebar + header + footer), shared with the invoice kit. */
export function SbLetterhead({ lab }: { lab: LabProfile }) {
  return (
    <>
      <div className="sb-side">
        <span>{lab.sidebarText ?? lab.name.toUpperCase()}</span>
      </div>
      <img className="sb-logo" src={lab.logoSrc} alt={lab.name} />
      <div className="sb-contact">
        {lab.addressLines.map((l, k) => (
          <div key={k}>{l}</div>
        ))}
        <div>
          <img src={lab.icons.phoneSrc} alt="" />
          {lab.phone}
        </div>
        <div>
          <img src={lab.icons.emailSrc} alt="" />
          {lab.email}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="sb-hrule" />
      <div className="sb-frule" />
      <div className="sb-flines">
        {(lab.footerLines ?? []).map((l, k) => (
          <div key={k}>{l}</div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- patient */

function PatientBlock({ report }: { report: Report }) {
  return (
    <div className="sb-patient">
      {patientFields(report).map((f) => (
        <div key={f.label}>
          <span className="sb-f-label">{f.label}</span>
          <span className={`sb-f-value${f.strong ? " strong" : ""}`}>{f.value}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ sections */

function SectionPart({ part }: { part: SbPart }) {
  const s = part.section;
  const meta = sectionMeta(s);
  return (
    <div className="sb-sec">
      <div className="sb-dept">
        {s.title}
        {part.continued && !subtitleOf(s) ? " (contd.)" : ""}
      </div>
      {subtitleOf(s) && (
        <div className="sb-title">
          {subtitleOf(s)}
          {part.continued ? " (contd.)" : ""}
        </div>
      )}
      {meta && <div className="sb-meta">{meta}</div>}
      {showsTableHeader(s) && <TableHeader section={s} />}
      {part.rows.map((row, k) => (
        <RowView key={k} row={row} section={s} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function TableHeader({ section }: { section: Section }) {
  if (isGrid(section)) {
    return (
      <div className="sb-row sb-th">
        {gridColumns(section).headers.map((c) => (
          <div key={c.key} className={`sb-cell ${al(c.align)}`} style={{ width: inch(c.w) }}>
            {c.header}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (isTwoColumn(section)) {
    return (
      <div className="sb-row sb-th">
        <div className="sb-cell l" style={{ width: inch(SB_COLS.name) }}>{STD_COLUMNS[0].header}</div>
        <div className="sb-cell l" style={{ width: inch(TWO_COL_RESULT_W) }}>{STD_COLUMNS[1].header}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="sb-row sb-th">
      {STD_COLUMNS.map((c) => (
        <div key={c.key} className={`sb-cell ${al(c.align)}`} style={{ width: inch(SB_COLS[c.key]) }}>
          {c.header}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function RowView({ row, section }: { row: Row; section: Section }) {
  const h = pt(sbRowHeight(row));
  switch (row.kind) {
    case "heading":
      return <div className="sb-sub">{row.text}</div>;
    case "text":
      return (
        <div className="sb-text" style={{ height: h }}>
          <span>
            <RichText value={row.content} />
          </span>
        </div>
      );
    case "cells": {
      const { cols } = gridColumns(section);
      return (
        <div className="sb-row" style={{ height: h }}>
          {cols.map((c, k) => (
            <div key={c.key} className={`sb-cell ${al(c.align)}`} style={{ width: inch(c.w) }}>
              <span>
                <RichText value={row.cells[k] ?? ""} />
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      );
    }
    case "test":
      return <TestRowView row={row} height={h} twoColumn={isTwoColumn(section)} />;
  }
}

function TestRowView({ row, height, twoColumn }: { row: TestRow; height: string; twoColumn: boolean }) {
  const f = flagOf(row);
  const cell = (key: keyof typeof SB_COLS, align: Align, children: ReactNode) => (
    <div className={`sb-cell ${al(align)}`} style={{ width: inch(SB_COLS[key]) }}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
  const name = cell(
    "name",
    "left",
    <>
      <span>
        {row.name}
        {row.abbr && <span className="sb-abbr">{` ${row.abbr}`}</span>}
      </span>
      {row.method && <span className="sb-method">{row.method}</span>}
    </>,
  );
  if (twoColumn) {
    return (
      <div className="sb-row" style={{ height }}>
        {name}
        <div className="sb-cell l" style={{ width: inch(TWO_COL_RESULT_W) }}>
          <span className={f.abnormal ? "sb-res-ab" : undefined} style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{row.result ?? ""}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="sb-row" style={{ height }}>
      {name}
      {cell("result", "center", <span className={f.abnormal ? "sb-res-ab" : undefined}>{row.result ?? ""}</span>)}
      {cell("flag", "center", f.label ? <span className="sb-pill" style={{ background: f.color }}>{f.label}</span> : null)}
      {cell("unit", "center", <span>{row.unit ?? ""}</span>)}
      {Array.isArray(row.range) ? (
        <div className="sb-cell l" style={{ width: inch(SB_COLS.range), paddingLeft: inch(SB_CELL_PAD) }}>
          <div className="sb-range-lines">
            {row.range.map((l, k) => (
              <span key={k}>{l}</span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        cell("range", "center", <span>{row.range ?? ""}</span>)
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function RichText({ value }: { value: Rich }) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return <>{value}</>;
  const runs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
  return (
    <>
      {runs.map((r, k) => (
        <span key={k} style={{ fontWeight: r.bold ? 800 : undefined, color: r.color, fontSize: r.size ? pt(r.size) : undefined }}>
          {r.text}
        </span>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## File: src/server/sidebar/SidebarReportPdf.tsx

```tsx
import { Document, Image, Page, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { PdfImage } from "../pdf/assets";
import type { Align, LabProfile, Report, ReportVariant, Rich, Row, Section, TestRow } from "../../shared/types";
import {
  SB_BODY,
  SB_CELL_PAD,
  SB_COLORS as C,
  SB_COLS,
  SB_CONTENT,
  SB_FONT,
  SB_FOOTER,
  SB_HEADER,
  SB_LEGAL,
  SB_PAGE,
  SB_PATIENT,
  SB_RIGHT,
  SB_ROWS as R,
  SB_SIDEBAR,
  SB_SIGN,
} from "./layout";
import { isGrid, sbLayoutPages, sbRowHeight, showsTableHeader, subtitleOf, type SbPart } from "./measure";
import { flagOf, gridColumns, isTwoColumn, LEGAL, LEGEND, patientFields, sectionMeta, STD_COLUMNS, TWO_COL_RESULT_W } from "./model";

/** Images pre-loaded as PNG/JPG buffers (see renderSidebarPdf). */
export interface SbPdfImages {
  logo: PdfImage;
  email: PdfImage;
  phone: PdfImage;
  qc?: PdfImage;
  signature: PdfImage;
  barcode?: PdfImage;
  qr: PdfImage;
}

const i = (n: number) => `${n}in`;
const justify = (a: Align = "left") => (a === "left" ? "flex-start" : a === "right" ? "flex-end" : "center");
const pageStyle = { fontFamily: SB_FONT, fontSize: R.fontSize, color: C.ink } as const;

/** Navy Sidebar report as a react-pdf Document — same geometry and page breaks as <SidebarReport/>. */
export function SidebarReportPdf({ report, variant, lab, images }: { report: Report; variant: ReportVariant; lab: LabProfile; images: SbPdfImages }) {
  const pages = sbLayoutPages(report);
  const p = SB_PATIENT;
  const qrX = SB_RIGHT - p.barcode.w / 2 - p.qr.s / 2;
  return (
    <Document title={`${report.patient.name} - Lab Report`} author={lab.name} creator={lab.name} producer={lab.name}>
      {pages.map((page, n) => (
        <Page key={n} size="A4" style={pageStyle}>
          {variant === "header" && <SbLetterheadPdf lab={lab} images={images} />}
          <PatientBlock report={report} />
          {images.barcode && (
            <Image src={images.barcode} style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(SB_RIGHT - p.barcode.w), top: i(p.y), width: i(p.barcode.w), height: i(p.barcode.h), objectFit: "fill" }} />
          )}
          <Image src={images.qr} style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(qrX), top: i(p.y + p.barcode.h + 0.07), width: i(p.qr.s), height: i(p.qr.s) }} />
          <Text
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              left: i(SB_RIGHT - p.barcode.w),
              width: i(p.barcode.w),
              top: i(p.y + p.barcode.h + 0.09 + p.qr.s),
              textAlign: "center",
              fontSize: p.qr.labelSize,
              color: C.muted,
            }}
          >
            Scan to verify
          </Text>

          <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(SB_CONTENT.x), width: i(SB_CONTENT.w), top: i(SB_BODY.top) }}>
            {page.parts.map((part, k) => (
              <SectionPart key={k} part={part} />
            ))}
            {page.isLast && (
              <View style={{ height: R.end, justifyContent: "center" }}>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 6.8, color: C.muted, marginBottom: 5 }}>{LEGEND}</Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 7, color: C.muted, textAlign: "center", letterSpacing: 1.4 }}>
                  {`— ${(report.endText ?? "End of Report").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")} —`}
                </Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>

          <Signature lab={lab} images={images} />
          <View
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              left: i(SB_CONTENT.x),
              width: i(SB_CONTENT.w),
              top: i(SB_LEGAL.y),
              flexDirection: "row",
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              borderTopWidth: 0.5,
              borderTopColor: C.line,
              paddingTop: 3,
              fontSize: SB_LEGAL.size,
              color: C.muted,
            }}
          >
            <Text>{LEGAL}</Text>
            <Text>{`Page ${n + 1} of ${pages.length}`}</Text>
          </View>
        </Page>
      ))}
    </Document>
  );
}

/** Blank A4 letterhead (sidebar + header + footer only). */
export function SidebarLetterheadPdf({ lab, images }: { lab: LabProfile; images: Pick<SbPdfImages, "logo" | "email" | "phone"> }) {
  return (
    <Document title={`${lab.name} - Letterhead`} author={lab.name} creator={lab.name} producer={lab.name}>
      <Page size="A4" style={pageStyle}>
        <SbLetterheadPdf lab={lab} images={images} />
      </Page>
    </Document>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- letterhead */

/** Letterhead layer (sidebar + header + footer), shared with the invoice kit. */
export function SbLetterheadPdf({ lab, images }: { lab: LabProfile; images: Pick<SbPdfImages, "logo" | "email" | "phone"> }) {
  const H = SB_HEADER;
  const lineH = H.contact.lineHeight;
  const contactRow = (children: ReactNode, k: number, icon?: PdfImage) => (
    <View key={k} style={{ height: i(lineH), flexDirection: "row", justifyContent: "flex-end", alignItems: "center" }}>
      {icon && <Image src={icon} style={{ width: i(H.contact.icon), height: i(H.contact.icon), marginRight: 4 }} />}
      <Text style={{ fontSize: H.contact.size }}>{children}</Text>
    </View>
  );
  const sideText = lab.sidebarText ?? lab.name.toUpperCase();
  const textBox = 6; // inches; wide enough for the rotated label
  return (
    <>
      <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, top: 0, width: i(SB_SIDEBAR.w), height: i(SB_PAGE.h), backgroundColor: C.navy }} />
      <Text
        style={{
          position: "absolute",
          left: i(SB_SIDEBAR.w / 2 - textBox / 2),
          top: i(SB_PAGE.h / 2) ,
          width: i(textBox),
          marginTop: -SB_SIDEBAR.textSize / 2,
          textAlign: "center",
          color: C.gold,
          fontWeight: 800,
          fontSize: SB_SIDEBAR.textSize,
          letterSpacing: SB_SIDEBAR.letterSpacing,
          lineHeight: 1,
          transform: "rotate(-90deg)",
        }}
      >
        {sideText}
      </Text>
      <Image
        src={images.logo}
        style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(H.logo.x), top: i(H.logo.y), width: i(H.logo.w), height: i(H.logo.h), objectFit: "contain", objectPositionX: 0 }}
      />
      <View style={{ position: "absolute", right: i(SB_PAGE.w - SB_RIGHT), top: i(H.contact.y), width: i(3.4) }}>
        {lab.addressLines.map((l, k) => contactRow(l, k))}
        {contactRow(lab.phone, 90, images.phone)}
        {contactRow(lab.email, 91, images.email)}
      </View>
      <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(SB_CONTENT.x), width: i(SB_CONTENT.w), top: i(H.rule.y), borderTopWidth: H.rule.width, borderTopColor: C.navy }} />
      <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(SB_CONTENT.x), width: i(SB_CONTENT.w), top: i(SB_FOOTER.rule.y), borderTopWidth: SB_FOOTER.rule.width, borderTopColor: C.navy }} />
      <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(SB_CONTENT.x), width: i(SB_CONTENT.w), top: i(SB_FOOTER.lines.y) }}>
        {(lab.footerLines ?? []).map((l, k) => (
          <View key={k} style={{ height: i(SB_FOOTER.lines.lineHeight), justifyContent: "center" }}>
            <Text
              style={{
                textAlign: "center",
                fontSize: SB_FOOTER.lines.size,
                color: k === 0 ? C.saffron : C.muted,
                fontWeight: k === 0 ? 700 : 400,
                letterSpacing: k === 0 ? 0.3 : 0,
              }}
            >
              {l}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>
    </>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- patient */

function PatientBlock({ report }: { report: Report }) {
  const g = SB_PATIENT.grid;
  return (
    <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(SB_CONTENT.x), top: i(SB_PATIENT.y), width: i(g.colW * 3), flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
      {patientFields(report).map((f) => (
        <View key={f.label} style={{ width: i(g.colW), height: i(g.rowH) }}>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: g.labelSize, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 0.4, color: C.muted, lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{f.label.toUpperCase()}</Text>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: g.valueSize, fontWeight: f.strong ? 800 : 600, lineHeight: 1.35 }}>{f.value}</Text>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ sections */

function SectionPart({ part }: { part: SbPart }) {
  const s = part.section;
  const meta = sectionMeta(s);
  return (
    <View style={{ marginBottom: R.sectionGap }}>
      <View style={{ height: R.dept, flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" }}>
        <View style={{ width: 6.75, height: 6.75, backgroundColor: C.saffron, borderRadius: 1.5, marginRight: 5.25 }} />
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 800, color: C.navy, letterSpacing: 0.25 }}>
          {`${s.title}${part.continued && !subtitleOf(s) ? " (contd.)" : ""}`}
        </Text>
      </View>
      {subtitleOf(s) ? (
        <View style={{ height: R.title, justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700 }}>{`${subtitleOf(s)}${part.continued ? " (contd.)" : ""}`}</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}
      {meta ? (
        <View style={{ height: R.meta, justifyContent: "center" }}>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 7, color: C.muted }}>{meta}</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}
      {showsTableHeader(s) && <TableHeader section={s} />}
      {part.rows.map((row, k) => (
        <RowView key={k} row={row} section={s} />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

const rowBox = (height: number) => ({ height, flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", borderBottomWidth: 0.5, borderBottomColor: C.line }) as const;

function Cell({ w, align = "left", padLeft, children }: { w: number; align?: Align; padLeft?: number; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: i(w),
        height: "100%",
        paddingLeft: i(padLeft ?? SB_CELL_PAD),
        paddingRight: i(SB_CELL_PAD),
        justifyContent: "center",
        alignItems: justify(align),
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

function TableHeader({ section }: { section: Section }) {
  const th = { fontSize: 7, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 0.5, color: C.muted } as const;
  const cols = isGrid(section)
    ? gridColumns(section).headers.map((c) => ({ key: c.key, w: c.w, align: c.align, header: c.header }))
    : isTwoColumn(section)
      ? [
          { key: "name", w: SB_COLS.name, align: "left" as Align, header: STD_COLUMNS[0].header },
          { key: "result", w: TWO_COL_RESULT_W, align: "left" as Align, header: STD_COLUMNS[1].header },
        ]
      : STD_COLUMNS.map((c) => ({ key: c.key, w: SB_COLS[c.key], align: c.align, header: c.header }));
  return (
    <View style={{ ...rowBox(R.tableHeader), borderBottomWidth: 1.2, borderBottomColor: C.navy }}>
      {cols.map((c) => (
        <Cell key={c.key} w={c.w} align={c.align}>
          <Text style={th}>{c.header.toUpperCase()}</Text>
        </Cell>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function RowView({ row, section }: { row: Row; section: Section }) {
  const h = sbRowHeight(row);
  switch (row.kind) {
    case "heading":
      return (
        <View style={{ ...rowBox(h), alignItems: "flex-end", paddingLeft: i(SB_CELL_PAD), paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          <Text style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: C.navy }}>{row.text}</Text>
        </View>
      );
    case "text":
      return (
        <View style={{ height: h, flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "flex-end", paddingLeft: i(SB_CELL_PAD), paddingBottom: 3 }}>
          <Text>
            <RichText value={row.content} />
          </Text>
        </View>
      );
    case "cells": {
      const { cols } = gridColumns(section);
      return (
        <View style={rowBox(h)}>
          {cols.map((c, k) => (
            <Cell key={c.key} w={c.w} align={c.align}>
              <Text>
                <RichText value={row.cells[k] ?? ""} />
              </Text>
            </Cell>
          ))}
        </View>
      );
    }
    case "test":
      return <TestRowView row={row} height={h} twoColumn={isTwoColumn(section)} />;
  }
}

function TestRowView({ row, height, twoColumn }: { row: TestRow; height: number; twoColumn: boolean }) {
  const f = flagOf(row);
  const name = (
    <Cell w={SB_COLS.name}>
      <Text>
        {row.name}
        {row.abbr ? <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{` ${row.abbr}`}</Text> : null}
      </Text>
      {row.method ? <Text style={{ fontSize: 6.8, color: C.muted }}>{row.method}</Text> : null}
    </Cell>
  );
  if (twoColumn) {
    return (
      <View style={rowBox(height)}>
        {name}
        <Cell w={TWO_COL_RESULT_W}>
          <Text style={{ fontWeight: f.abnormal ? 800 : 700, color: f.abnormal ? C.red : undefined }}>{row.result ?? ""}</Text>
        </Cell>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View style={rowBox(height)}>
      {name}
      <Cell w={SB_COLS.result} align="center">
        <Text style={f.abnormal ? { color: C.red, fontWeight: 800 } : undefined}>{row.result ?? ""}</Text>
      </Cell>
      <Cell w={SB_COLS.flag} align="center">
        {f.label ? (
          <View style={{ backgroundColor: f.color, borderRadius: 2.25, paddingHorizontal: 3, minWidth: 11.25, height: 9 }}>
            <Text style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 6.8, fontWeight: 800, textAlign: "center", lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{f.label}</Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </Cell>
      <Cell w={SB_COLS.unit} align="center">
        <Text>{row.unit ?? ""}</Text>
      </Cell>
      {Array.isArray(row.range) ? (
        <Cell w={SB_COLS.range}>
          {row.range.map((l, k) => (
            <Text key={k} style={{ fontSize: 7, lineHeight: 9 / 7 }}>
              {l}
            </Text>
          ))}
        </Cell>
      ) : (
        <Cell w={SB_COLS.range} align="center">
          <Text>{row.range ?? ""}</Text>
        </Cell>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- signature */

function Signature({ lab, images }: { lab: LabProfile; images: SbPdfImages }) {
  const S = SB_SIGN;
  return (
    <>
      {images.qc && <Image src={images.qc} style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(S.qc.x), top: i(S.qc.y), width: i(S.qc.s), height: i(S.qc.s) }} />}
      <Image
        src={images.signature}
        style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(S.centerX - S.sign.w / 2), top: i(S.sign.y), width: i(S.sign.w), height: i(S.sign.h), objectFit: "contain" }}
      />
      <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(S.centerX - 1.3), width: i(2.6), top: i(S.nameY) }}>
        <Text style={{ textAlign: "center", fontSize: S.nameSize, fontWeight: 800 }}>{lab.signatory.name}</Text>
        <Text style={{ textAlign: "center", fontSize: S.roleSize, color: C.muted }}>{lab.signatory.designation}</Text>
      </View>
    </>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- rich */

function RichText({ value }: { value: Rich }) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return <>{value}</>;
  const runs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
  return (
    <>
      {runs.map((r, k) => (
        <Text key={k} style={{ fontWeight: r.bold ? 800 : 400, color: r.color, fontSize: r.size }}>
          {r.text}
        </Text>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## File: src/server/sidebar/layout.ts

```ts
/**
 * "Navy Sidebar" design — geometry shared by the HTML preview and the Node PDF renderer.
 * Inches from the page's top-left corner (A4 = 8.27 × 11.69in); font sizes in pt.
 *
 * The page has two layers:
 *   LETTERHEAD (stationery) — sidebar, header, footer. Printed only in the "header" variant
 *                             (or pre-printed on the paper for the "non-header" variant).
 *   REPORT                  — patient block, results, signature, page number. Always printed,
 *                             at exactly the same place in both variants.
 */
export const SB_PAGE = { w: 8.27, h: 11.69 };

export const SB_COLORS = {
  navy: "#14264A",
  saffron: "#C2410C",
  gold: "#E9A23B",
  ink: "#111827",
  muted: "#5A6478",
  line: "#E4E7EC",
  zebra: "#F6F8FB",
  red: "#D92D20",
  blue: "#1570EF",
};

export const SB_FONT = "Manrope";

/** Content column (everything except the sidebar) */
export const SB_CONTENT = { x: 0.85, w: 6.97 };
export const SB_RIGHT = SB_CONTENT.x + SB_CONTENT.w; // 7.82in

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- letterhead */
export const SB_SIDEBAR = { w: 0.45, textSize: 10, letterSpacing: 3.6 };
export const SB_HEADER = {
  logo: { x: SB_CONTENT.x, y: 0.3, w: 2.6, h: 0.95 },
  contact: { y: 0.36, size: 9, lineHeight: 0.2, icon: 0.12 },
  rule: { y: 1.42, width: 0.75 },
};
export const SB_FOOTER = {
  rule: { y: 10.98, width: 1 },
  lines: { y: 11.06, size: 7.5, lineHeight: 0.18 },
};

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- report */
export const SB_PATIENT = {
  y: 1.58,
  /** 3 × 3 grid of label/value fields */
  grid: { colW: 1.75, rowH: 0.37, labelSize: 6.5, valueSize: 9.5 },
  barcode: { w: 1.45, h: 0.34 },
  qr: { s: 0.68, labelSize: 6 },
};
/** Result area (between patient block and signature zone) */
export const SB_BODY = { top: 2.92, bottom: 9.55 };

const SB_QC_SIZE = 0.72;
export const SB_SIGN = {
  /** QC stamp: bottom centre of the content column, in the signature band */
  qc: { x: SB_CONTENT.x + (SB_CONTENT.w - SB_QC_SIZE) / 2, y: 9.7, s: SB_QC_SIZE },
  sign: { w: 1.45, h: 0.47, y: 9.66 },
  /** signature block is centred on this x (keeps the 1.9in-wide name inside the margin) */
  centerX: SB_RIGHT - 1.15,
  nameY: 10.16,
  nameSize: 9,
  roleSize: 8.5,
};
export const SB_LEGAL = { y: 10.64, size: 6.8 };

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- result table */
/** Standard columns (inches, sum = content width). Sized from measured Manrope text widths:
 *  name fits "Mean Corpuscular Haemoglobin Concentration (MCHC)", result fits a bold "Non - Reactive",
 *  range fits "200 – 499: Hyper triglyceridemic". `npm run smoke` re-checks every template. */
export const SB_COLS = { name: 3.2, result: 0.98, flag: 0.39, unit: 0.8, range: 1.6 };
export const SB_CELL_PAD = 0.06;

/** Row heights (pt). Both renderers use exactly these, so pages break identically. */
export const SB_ROWS = {
  fontSize: 8.6,
  dept: 24, // department title (HEMATOLOGY …)
  title: 15, // test name line
  meta: 10, // specimen / method line
  tableHeader: 17,
  heading: 17, // sub-heading inside a table
  test: 15.5,
  method: 9.5, // extra for a method line under a test
  rangeLine: 9, // per line of a multi-line range
  cells: 18,
  text: 17,
  sectionGap: 10,
  end: 34, // legend + "End of Report"
};
```

## File: src/server/sidebar/measure.ts

```ts
import type { Report, Row, Section } from "../../shared/types";
import { SB_BODY, SB_ROWS as R } from "./layout";

/** A slice of a section placed on one page. */
export interface SbPart {
  section: Section;
  rows: Row[];
  /** true when this slice continues a section from the previous page */
  continued: boolean;
}
export interface SbPage {
  parts: SbPart[];
  isLast: boolean;
}

/** Sections whose rows are all plain tests use the standard 5-column results table. */
export const isGrid = (s: Section) => s.rows.some((r) => r.kind === "cells");
const hasMeta = (s: Section) => !!(s.specimen || s.method);
export const showsTableHeader = (s: Section) => !(isGrid(s) && s.hideColumnHeader);

const same = (a?: string, b?: string) => !!a && !!b && a.trim().toLowerCase() === b.trim().toLowerCase();
/** Test-name line, unless it just repeats the department title ("SEMEN ANALYSIS" / "Semen Analysis"). */
export const subtitleOf = (s: Section): string | undefined => (s.subtitle && !same(s.subtitle, s.title) ? s.subtitle : undefined);
/** Rows as printed: a sub-heading that repeats the test name ("Lipid Profile") is dropped. */
export const displayRows = (s: Section): Row[] => s.rows.filter((r) => !(r.kind === "heading" && (same(r.text, s.subtitle) || same(r.text, s.title))));

export function sbRowHeight(row: Row): number {
  switch (row.kind) {
    case "heading":
      return R.heading;
    case "cells":
      return R.cells;
    case "text":
      return R.text + (row.spaceBefore ? 8 : 0);
    case "test": {
      let h = R.test;
      if (Array.isArray(row.range)) h = Math.max(h, row.range.length * R.rangeLine + 6);
      if (row.method) h += R.method;
      return h;
    }
  }
}

export function sbSectionHead(s: Section): number {
  return R.dept + (subtitleOf(s) ? R.title : 0) + (hasMeta(s) ? R.meta : 0) + (showsTableHeader(s) ? R.tableHeader : 0);
}

export const SB_CAPACITY = (SB_BODY.bottom - SB_BODY.top) * 72;

/** Splits the report into A4 pages for the Navy Sidebar design. */
export function sbLayoutPages(report: Report): SbPage[] {
  const pages: SbPart[][] = [[]];
  let used = 0;
  const newPage = () => {
    pages.push([]);
    used = 0;
  };

  report.sections.forEach((section, si) => {
    const last = si === report.sections.length - 1;
    if (section.pageBreakBefore && pages[pages.length - 1].length) newPage();
    const head = sbSectionHead(section);
    const rows = displayRows(section);
    const hs = rows.map(sbRowHeight);
    const need = (i: number) => {
      let h = hs[i];
      if (rows[i].kind === "heading" && i + 1 < hs.length) h += hs[i + 1];
      if (last && i === hs.length - 1) h += R.end;
      return h;
    };

    let part: Row[] = [];
    let continued = false;
    const flush = () => {
      pages[pages.length - 1].push({ section, rows: part, continued });
      part = [];
    };

    if (used > 0 && used + head + (hs.length ? need(0) : 0) > SB_CAPACITY) newPage();
    used += head;
    rows.forEach((row, i) => {
      if (part.length && used + need(i) > SB_CAPACITY) {
        flush();
        newPage();
        continued = true;
        used = head;
      }
      part.push(row);
      used += hs[i];
    });
    flush();
    used += R.sectionGap;
  });

  return pages.map((parts, i) => ({ parts, isLast: i === pages.length - 1 }));
}
```

## File: src/server/sidebar/model.ts

```ts
// Display logic shared by the HTML and PDF renderers of the Navy Sidebar design.
import { formatDate, formatDateTime, formatDoctor, fullName, resolveFlag } from "../format";
import { headerCells } from "../measure";
import type { Align, Report, Section, TestRow } from "../../shared/types";
import { SB_COLORS, SB_COLS, SB_CONTENT } from "./layout";

export interface Field {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  strong?: boolean;
}

/** 3 × 3 patient grid, filled row by row. */
export function patientFields(report: Report): Field[] {
  const p = report.patient;
  const specimens = [...new Set(report.sections.map((s) => s.specimen).filter(Boolean))];
  const dash = (v?: string) => (v && v.trim() ? v : "-");
  return [
    { label: "Patient Name", value: fullName(p), strong: true },
    { label: "Age / Sex", value: `${p.age} ${p.ageUnit ?? "Year(s)"} / ${p.sex}` },
    { label: "Patient ID", value: dash(p.patientId) },
    { label: "Ref. Doctor", value: formatDoctor(p.refDoctor) },
    { label: "Sample ID", value: dash(p.sampleId) },
    { label: "Sample Type", value: dash(p.sampleType ?? (specimens.length > 1 ? "Multiple (see tests)" : specimens[0])) },
    { label: "Collected", value: formatDateTime(p.collectedAt) || formatDate(p.sampleCollectionDate) },
    { label: "Registered", value: dash(formatDateTime(p.registeredAt)) },
    { label: "Reported", value: dash(formatDateTime(p.reportedAt)) },
  ];
}

/** H / L / A pill for a test row ("" when normal). */
export function flagOf(row: TestRow): { label: "" | "H" | "L" | "A"; color: string; abnormal: boolean } {
  const f = resolveFlag(row);
  if (f === "high") return { label: "H", color: SB_COLORS.red, abnormal: true };
  if (f === "low") return { label: "L", color: SB_COLORS.blue, abnormal: true };
  if (f === "abnormal") return { label: "A", color: SB_COLORS.red, abnormal: true };
  return { label: "", color: "", abnormal: false };
}

/** Sections with only Test | Result (Blood Group, MP): the result gets the full remaining width. */
export const isTwoColumn = (s: Section) => !s.columns.some((c) => c.key === "unit" || c.key === "range");
export const TWO_COL_RESULT_W = SB_CONTENT.w - SB_COLS.name;

export const STD_COLUMNS: { key: keyof typeof SB_COLS; header: string; align: Align }[] = [
  { key: "name", header: "Test Description", align: "left" },
  { key: "result", header: "Result", align: "center" },
  { key: "flag", header: "Flag", align: "center" },
  { key: "unit", header: "Unit", align: "center" },
  { key: "range", header: "Biological Ref. Interval", align: "center" },
];

/** Grid sections (Widal, Semen…) keep their own columns, scaled to the content width. */
export function gridColumns(s: Section) {
  const total = s.columns.reduce((a, c) => a + c.width, 0);
  const k = SB_CONTENT.w / total;
  return {
    cols: s.columns.map((c) => ({ ...c, w: c.width * k, align: c.align ?? ("left" as Align) })),
    headers: headerCells(s).map((c) => ({ ...c, w: c.spanWidth * k, align: c.headerAlign ?? c.align ?? ("left" as Align) })),
  };
}

export const sectionMeta = (s: Section) =>
  [s.specimen && `Specimen: ${s.specimen}`, s.method && `Method: ${s.method}`].filter(Boolean).join("   •   ");

export const LEGEND = "H / L = above / below the biological reference interval;  A = abnormal.  Results should be correlated clinically.";
export const LEGAL = "This is an electronically verified report. Scan the QR code to confirm its details.";
```
