## File: src/server/signatures.ts

```ts
// Real signatures stay OUT of git. The public package ships a placeholder; a server points these
// environment variables at private image files and every report/invoice uses them automatically:
//
//   MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE=/secure/signature.jpg            (both variants)
//   MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE=/secure/sig-scan.jpg      (header variant, overrides the above)
//   MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE=/secure/sig-green.png  (non-header variant, overrides the above)
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { extname, resolve } from "node:path";
import { MGPL_LAB } from "./lab";
import type { LabProfile } from "../shared/types";

const MIME: Record<string, string> = { ".png": "image/png", ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpeg": "image/jpeg", ".svg": "image/svg+xml" };
const cache = new Map<string, string>();

/** A private image file as a data URI (usable in both the PDF and the HTML output). */
export function imageFileToDataUri(path: string): string {
  const abs = resolve(path);
  let uri = cache.get(abs);
  if (!uri) {
    const type = MIME[extname(abs).toLowerCase()];
    if (!type) throw new Error(`Signature must be .png, .jpg or .svg: ${path}`);
    uri = `data:${type};base64,${readFileSync(abs).toString("base64")}`;
    cache.set(abs, uri);
  }
  return uri;
}

/** Lab profile with signatures loaded from private files (undefined entries keep the current image). */
export function withSignatureFiles(lab: LabProfile, files: { header?: string; nonHeader?: string }): LabProfile {
  return {
    ...lab,
    signatory: {
      ...lab.signatory,
      signatureHeaderSrc: files.header ? imageFileToDataUri(files.header) : lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc,
      signatureNonHeaderSrc: files.nonHeader ? imageFileToDataUri(files.nonHeader) : lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc,
    },
  };
}

/** `lab` with signatures taken from the MGPL_SIGNATURE_* environment variables, if set. */
export function labFromEnv(lab: LabProfile = MGPL_LAB, env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): LabProfile {
  const both = env.MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE;
  const header = env.MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE ?? both;
  const nonHeader = env.MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE ?? both;
  return header || nonHeader ? withSignatureFiles(lab, { header, nonHeader }) : lab;
}

/** The lab used when none is passed: MGPL_LAB + private signatures from the environment. */
export const defaultLab = (): LabProfile => labFromEnv(MGPL_LAB);
```

```ts
import {
  BODY_TOP,
  COLORS,
  END,
  FONTS,
  FOOTER_HEADER as FH,
  LETTERHEAD as LH,
  PATIENT as P,
  SECTION,
  TITLE_BAR as TB,
} from "./layout";

const i = (n: number) => `${n}in`;
const box = (b: { x: number; y: number; w?: number; h?: number; s?: number }): string =>
  `left:${i(b.x)};top:${i(b.y)};width:${i(b.w ?? b.s!)};height:${i(b.h ?? b.s!)};`;

/**
 * Report stylesheet for the HTML preview. Injected by <ReportDocument/>, so it works in any
 * page with no global CSS import. Geometry comes from layout.ts (shared with the PDF renderer).
 *
 * @param fontBase URL folder holding the files from /public/report-fonts
 */
export function reportCss(fontBase = "/report-fonts"): string {
  const face = (family: string, file: string, weight = 400, style = "normal") =>
    `@font-face{font-family:"${family}";src:url("${fontBase}/${file}") format("woff");font-weight:${weight};font-style:${style};font-display:block;}`;

  return `
${face(FONTS.body, "carlito-400.woff")}
${face(FONTS.body, "carlito-700.woff", 700)}
${face(FONTS.body, "carlito-400-italic.woff", 400, "italic")}
${face(FONTS.body, "carlito-700-italic.woff", 700, "italic")}
${face(FONTS.title, "archivo-black-400.woff")}
${face(FONTS.address, "barlow-semi-condensed-300.woff", 300)}

@page { size: A4; margin: 0; }

.mg-doc {
  --mg-font: "${FONTS.body}", Calibri, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 24px;
  -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact;
}
.mg-doc *, .mg-doc *::before, .mg-doc *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

.mg-page {
  position: relative; width: 210mm; height: 297mm; overflow: hidden;
  background: #fff; color: #000;
  font-family: var(--mg-font); font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.22;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}
.mg-page img { position: absolute; display: block; max-width: none; object-fit: contain; }

/* Letterhead */
.mg-logo { ${box(LH.logo)} object-position: left center; }
.mg-divider { position:absolute; left:${i(LH.divider.x)}; top:${i(LH.divider.y)}; height:${i(LH.divider.h)}; border-left:${LH.divider.width}pt solid ${COLORS.divider}; }
.mg-address { position:absolute; left:${i(LH.address.x)}; top:${i(LH.address.y)}; font-family:"${FONTS.address}",sans-serif; font-weight:300; font-size:${LH.address.size}pt; line-height:${i(LH.address.lineHeight)}; white-space:nowrap; }
.mg-rule { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:${i(LH.rule.y)}; border-top:${LH.rule.width}pt solid #000; }

/* Body */
.mg-body { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:${i(BODY_TOP)}; }

.mg-titlebar {
  margin-left:${i(TB.x)}; width:${i(TB.w)}; height:${i(TB.h)};
  background:${COLORS.navy}; color:#fff; border:0.5pt solid #000;
  font-weight:700; font-size:${TB.size}pt; line-height:${i(TB.h - 0.01)}; text-align:center;
}

.mg-patient { position:relative; height:${i(P.height)}; font-size:${P.size}pt; }
.mg-prow { position:absolute; line-height:${i(P.lineHeight)}; white-space:nowrap; }
.mg-p-name { left:${i(P.name.x)}; top:${i(P.name.y)}; }
.mg-p-age { left:${i(P.age.x)}; top:${i(P.age.y)}; }
.mg-p-sex { left:${i(P.sex.x)}; top:${i(P.sex.y)}; }
.mg-p-ref { left:${i(P.ref.x)}; top:${i(P.ref.y)}; }
.mg-p-date { left:${i(P.date.x)}; top:${i(P.date.y)}; }
.mg-p-id { left:${i(P.id.x)}; top:${i(P.id.y)}; }
.mg-barcode { position:absolute; ${box(P.barcode)} }
.mg-barcode svg { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; }
.mg-pline { position:absolute; left:${i(P.line.x)}; width:${i(P.line.w)}; top:${i(P.line.y)}; border-top:${P.line.width}pt solid ${COLORS.patientLine}; }

/* Sections — every row gets an exact height from measure.ts (same as the PDF) */
.mg-section { margin-bottom:${i(SECTION.gapAfter)}; }
.mg-sec-head { background:${COLORS.band}; border:${SECTION.border}pt solid #000; }
.mg-sec-title { font-family:"${FONTS.title}",sans-serif; text-align:center; white-space:nowrap; }

/* Footer (same position in both variants) */
.mg-f-email-icon { ${box(FH.emailIcon)} }
.mg-f-phone-icon { ${box(FH.phoneIcon)} }
.mg-f-text { position:absolute; font-weight:700; font-size:${FH.size}pt; line-height:${i(FH.lineHeight)}; white-space:nowrap; }
.mg-f-email { left:${i(FH.email.x)}; top:${i(FH.email.y)}; }
.mg-f-email span { color:${COLORS.email}; }
.mg-f-phone { left:${i(FH.phone.x)}; top:${i(FH.phone.y)}; }

@media print {
  html, body { margin:0 !important; padding:0 !important; background:#fff !important; }
  .mg-doc { display:block; gap:0; }
  .mg-page { box-shadow:none; break-after:page; page-break-after:always; }
  .mg-page:last-child { break-after:auto; page-break-after:auto; }
}
`;
}
```

```ts
export const hba1c: ReportTemplate = {
  id: "hba1c",
  name: "Glycated Haemoglobin (HbA1c)",
  specimen: "Whole Blood (EDTA)",
  category: "Biochemistry",
  fields: [
    { key: "hba1c", label: "HbA1c", unit: "%" },
    { key: "eag", label: "Estimated Average Glucose (leave empty to calculate)", unit: "mg/dL" },
  ],
  build: (r) => {
    const v = typeof r.hba1c === "string" ? r.hba1c : (r.hba1c as { value?: string } | undefined)?.value;
    const a1c = parseFloat(v ?? "");
    // ADA: eAG (mg/dL) = 28.7 × HbA1c − 46.7
    const eag = (r.eag as string | undefined) ?? (Number.isFinite(a1c) ? (28.7 * a1c - 46.7).toFixed(1) : undefined);
    const flag = !Number.isFinite(a1c) ? "normal" : a1c >= 5.7 ? "high" : "normal";
    const rows: Row[] = [
      h("Glycated Haemoglobin"),
      t("hba1c", "HbA1c", "%", ["< 5.7 : Non-diabetic", "5.7 - 6.4 : Pre-diabetic", ">= 6.5 : Diabetic"], { flag }),
      t("eag", "Estimated Average Glucose (eAG)", "mg/dL", "-"),
    ];
    return [{ title: TITLE, columns: COLS_LIPID, rows: fillRows(rows, { ...r, eag }), style: { ...sectionStyle, rowGap: 12, headingGap: 4, rangeSize: 8 } }];
  },
  sample: { hba1c: "7.2" },
};
```

```ts
  sample: {
    colour: "Yellow", consistency: "Semi Solid", reaction: "Alkaline", blood: "Absent", mucus: "Present (+)",
    glucose: "Absent", occultBlood: "Absent", vegCells: "Few", ova: "Absent", cysts: "Absent", pusCells: "0 - 2",
    rbc: "Nil", epithelial: "Nil", bacteria: "Few", fat: "Nil",
  },

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------- Semen */

export interface SemenResults extends Results {
  volume?: ResultValue;
  liquefaction?: ResultValue;
  ph?: ResultValue;
  /** million/ml — printed red when below 60 */
  spermCount?: ResultValue;
  motility?: ResultValue;
  morphology?: ResultValue;
  pusCells?: ResultValue;
  rbc?: ResultValue;
  result?: ResultValue;
}

const val = (v: ResultValue | undefined): { text: string; abnormal: boolean } => {
  if (v === undefined) return { text: "", abnormal: false };
  if (typeof v === "string") return { text: v, abnormal: false };
  return { text: v.value ?? "", abnormal: !!v.flag && v.flag !== "normal" && v.flag !== "auto" };
};

const red = (v: ResultValue | undefined): Rich => {
  const { text, abnormal } = val(v);
  return abnormal ? { text, color: "#FF0000" } : text;
};

export const semen: ReportTemplate<SemenResults> = {
  id: "semen",
  name: "Semen Analysis",
  category: "Clinical Pathology",
  specimen: "Semen",
  fields: [
    { key: "volume", label: "Volume" },
    { key: "liquefaction", label: "Liquefaction Time" },
    { key: "ph", label: "pH" },
    { key: "spermCount", label: "Sperm Count", unit: "million/ml", range: "60 – 150" },
    { key: "motility", label: "Motility" },
    { key: "morphology", label: "Morphology" },
    { key: "pusCells", label: "Pus Cells", unit: HPF },
    { key: "rbc", label: "RBC's", unit: HPF },
    { key: "result", label: "Result" },
  ],
  build: (r) => {
    const count = val(r.spermCount);
    const low = count.abnormal || (parseFloat(count.text) < 60 && !Number.isNaN(parseFloat(count.text)));
    const rows: Row[] = [
      h("Gross Examination"),
      { kind: "cells", cells: ["Volume:", red(r.volume)] },
      { kind: "cells", cells: ["Liquefaction Time:", red(r.liquefaction)] },
      { kind: "cells", cells: ["pH:", red(r.ph)] },
      h("Microscopic Examination"),
      {
        kind: "cells",
        cells: [
          "Sperm Count:",
          [{ text: count.text, color: low ? "#FF0000" : undefined }, { text: "million/ml" }],
          "(Normal Range 60 – 150 million/mL)",
        ],
      },
      { kind: "cells", cells: ["Motility:", red(r.motility)] },
      { kind: "cells", cells: ["Morphology:", red(r.morphology)] },
      { kind: "cells", cells: ["Pus Cells:", red(r.pusCells), HPF] },
      { kind: "cells", cells: ["RBC’s:", red(r.rbc), HPF] },
      { kind: "cells", cells: ["Result:", red(r.result)] },
    ];
    return [{ title: "SEMEN ANALYSIS", columns: COLS_SEMEN, hideColumnHeader: true, rows, style: { titleSize: 13, rowGap: 11, headingGap: 11 } }];
  },
  sample: {
    volume: "2ml",
    liquefaction: "30 Minutes",
    ph: "Alkaline (7.5)",
    spermCount: "35",
    motility: "50%",
    morphology: "Normal",
    pusCells: { value: "0 - 2", flag: "abnormal" },
    rbc: { value: "0 – 2", flag: "abnormal" },
    result: { value: "Oligospermic", flag: "abnormal" },
  },
};
```

## File: src/server/templates/helpers.ts

```ts
import type { Column, Flag, Patient, Rich, Row, Section, SectionStyle, TestRow } from "../../shared/types";

/** What an app passes for one test line. A plain string is just the result. */
export type ResultValue =
  | string
  | {
      value?: string;
      flag?: Flag;
      /** Override the default reference range (e.g. male/female) */
      range?: string | string[];
      unit?: string;
      method?: string;
    };

/** Results for one template, keyed by the row keys listed in the template. */
export type Results = Record<string, ResultValue | string[] | undefined>;

export interface BuildContext {
  patient?: Patient;
}

export interface ReportTemplate<R extends Results = Results> {
  id: string;
  /** Display name, e.g. "Complete Blood Count (CBC)" */
  name: string;
  /** Row keys this template understands (for building entry forms) */
  /** Department, for grouping in pickers */
  category?: string;
  /** Printed under the test name (Navy Sidebar design) */
  specimen?: string;
  method?: string;
  fields: { key: string; label: string; unit?: string; range?: string | string[] }[];
  build(results: R, ctx: BuildContext): Section[];
  /** Results taken from the original Word design — used for the preview */
  sample: R;
}

/** Shorthand for a test row definition */
export const t = (
  key: string,
  name: string,
  unit?: string,
  range?: string | string[],
  extra: Partial<TestRow> = {},
): TestRow => ({ kind: "test", key, name, unit, range, ...extra });

export const h = (text: string, size?: number): Row => ({ kind: "heading", text, size });

/** Puts results into the template's test rows.
 *  onlyFilled: drop test rows that have no result (e.g. pick BSF / BSPP / RBS). */
export function fillRows(rows: Row[], results: Results, onlyFilled = false, ctx: BuildContext = {}): Row[] {
  const out: Row[] = [];
  const sex = sexOf(ctx.patient);
  for (let row of rows) {
    if (row.kind === "test" && row.rangeBySex && sex) row = { ...row, range: row.rangeBySex[sex] };
    if (row.kind !== "test" || !row.key) {
      out.push(row);
      continue;
    }
    const r = results[row.key];
    if (r === undefined || r === "") {
      if (!onlyFilled) out.push(row);
      continue;
    }
    if (typeof r === "string") out.push({ ...row, result: r });
    else if (Array.isArray(r)) out.push({ ...row, result: r.join(" ") });
    else
      out.push({
        ...row,
        result: r.value,
        flag: r.flag ?? row.flag,
        range: r.range ?? row.range,
        unit: r.unit ?? row.unit,
        method: r.method ?? row.method,
      });
  }
  // Drop headings left with nothing under them
  if (onlyFilled) {
    return out.filter((row, i) => {
      if (row.kind !== "heading") return true;
      const next = out[i + 1];
      return next && next.kind !== "heading";
    });
  }
  return out;
}

/** "male" / "female" from free-text sex ("M", "Male", "MALE", "Female", "F"…) */
export function sexOf(p?: Patient): "male" | "female" | undefined {
  const s = p?.sex?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";
  if (s.startsWith("f")) return "female";
  if (s.startsWith("m")) return "male";
  return undefined;
}

export const fieldsOf = (rows: Row[]) =>
  rows
    .filter((r): r is TestRow => r.kind === "test" && !!r.key)
    .map((r) => ({ key: r.key!, label: r.name + (r.abbr ? ` ${r.abbr}` : ""), unit: r.unit, range: r.range }));

/** "+ve" in red bold, "-ve" in blue — Widal styling */
export function titre(v: string): Rich {
  const pos = /^\+|pos/i.test(v.trim());
  return pos ? { text: v, bold: true, color: "#FF0000" } : { text: v, color: "#00B0F0" };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ columns */
// Widths are in inches; each preset reproduces the column positions of the Word designs.

/** Test | Result | Unit | Biological Reference Ranges — normal width (LFT, HB, Blood sugar) */
export const COLS_STD: Column[] = [
  { key: "name", header: "Test Description", width: 2.35, headerPadLeft: 0.08 },
  { key: "result", header: "Result", width: 0.9, align: "center" },
  { key: "unit", header: "Unit", width: 1.05, align: "center" },
  { key: "range", header: "Biological Reference Ranges", width: 1.97, align: "center" },
];

/** CBC — full width table */
export const COLS_CBC: Column[] = [
  { key: "name", header: "Test Description", width: 3.49, headerPadLeft: 0.08 },
  { key: "result", header: "Result", width: 0.9, align: "center" },
  { key: "unit", header: "Unit", width: 1.05, align: "center" },
  { key: "range", header: "Biological Reference Ranges", width: 1.94, align: "center" },
];

/** Lipid profile — multi-line ranges, left aligned */
export const COLS_LIPID: Column[] = [
  { key: "name", header: "Test Description", width: 2.4, headerPadLeft: 0.08 },
  { key: "result", header: "Result", width: 0.9, align: "center" },
  { key: "unit", header: "Unit", width: 1.0, align: "center" },
  { key: "range", header: "Biological Reference Ranges", width: 1.97, align: "left", headerAlign: "center", padLeft: 0.6 },
];

/** Test | Result | Reference Range — serology (Dengue, HIV, HBsAg, VDRL) */
export const COLS_SEROLOGY: Column[] = [
  { key: "name", header: "Test Description", width: 2.4, headerPadLeft: 0.08 },
  { key: "result", header: "Result", width: 1.7, align: "center" },
  { key: "range", header: "Reference Range", width: 2.17, align: "left", headerAlign: "center", padLeft: 0.48 },
];

/** Test | Result — Blood group, MP */
export const COLS_TWO: Column[] = [
  { key: "name", header: "Test Description", width: 3.0, headerPadLeft: 0.08 },
  { key: "result", header: "Result", width: 3.27, headerPadLeft: 0.08 },
];

/** Test | Result | Biological Reference Ranges — RA factor */
export const COLS_RA: Column[] = [
  { key: "name", header: "Test Description", width: 2.4, headerPadLeft: 0.08 },
  { key: "result", header: "Result", width: 0.9, align: "center" },
  { key: "range", header: "Biological Reference Ranges", width: 2.67, align: "center" },
];

/** Test | Result | Unit — Urine / Stool routine */
export const COLS_ROUTINE: Column[] = [
  { key: "name", header: "Test Description", width: 2.6, headerPadLeft: 0.08 },
  { key: "result", header: "Result", width: 1.42, align: "center" },
  { key: "unit", header: "Unit", width: 2.25, align: "center", padLeft: 0.43 },
];

/** Widal titre grid */
export const COLS_WIDAL: Column[] = [
  { key: "c0", header: "WIDAL TEST", width: 0.9, padLeft: 0.14, headerPadLeft: 0.08, headerSpan: 2 },
  { key: "c1", header: "", width: 0.93 },
  { key: "t40", header: "1:40", width: 0.8, align: "center" },
  { key: "t80", header: "1:80", width: 0.84, align: "center" },
  { key: "t160", header: "1:160", width: 0.82, align: "center" },
  { key: "t320", header: "1:320", width: 1.0, align: "center" },
  { key: "t640", header: "1:640", width: 0.58, align: "center" },
];

/** Label | Value | Extra — Semen analysis (no column header) */
export const COLS_SEMEN: Column[] = [
  { key: "c0", header: "", width: 1.5 },
  { key: "c1", header: "", width: 1.0 },
  { key: "c2", header: "", width: 3.77 },
];

/** Builds a standard one-section template (Test | Result | Unit | Range). */
export function panel(def: {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  title: string;
  rows: Row[];
  columns?: Column[];
  /** Only print the rows that have a result (à-la-carte panels) */
  onlyFilled?: boolean;
  style?: SectionStyle;
  wide?: boolean;
  specimen?: string;
  method?: string;
  sample: Results;
}): ReportTemplate {
  return {
    id: def.id,
    name: def.name,
    category: def.category,
    specimen: def.specimen,
    method: def.method,
    fields: fieldsOf(def.rows),
    build: (r, ctx) => [
      { title: def.title, columns: def.columns ?? COLS_STD, wide: def.wide, rows: fillRows(def.rows, r, def.onlyFilled, ctx), style: def.style },
    ],
    sample: def.sample,
  };
}
```

## File: src/server/templates/index.ts

```ts
import type { Patient, Report } from "../../shared/types";
import { biochemistry, bloodSugar, electrolytes, hba1c, ironProfile, kft, lft, lipid, rft } from "./biochemistry";
import { semen, stool, upt, urine } from "./clinicalPathology";
import { bloodGroup, btCt, cbc, esr, hb, mp, ptInr } from "./hematology";
import type { ReportTemplate, Results } from "./helpers";
import { psa, thyroid, vitaminB12, vitaminD } from "./immunoassay";
import { crpAso, dengue, hivHbsagVdrl, malariaAntigen, raFactor, typhidot, widal } from "./serology";

export * from "./helpers";

/** All templates, keyed by id. */
export const TEMPLATES = {
  // Hematology
  cbc,
  hb,
  esr,
  "blood-group": bloodGroup,
  mp,
  "bt-ct": btCt,
  "pt-inr": ptInr,
  // Biochemistry
  "blood-sugar": bloodSugar,
  hba1c,
  lft,
  rft,
  kft,
  electrolytes,
  lipid,
  "iron-profile": ironProfile,
  biochemistry,
  // Immunoassay
  thyroid,
  "vitamin-d": vitaminD,
  "vitamin-b12": vitaminB12,
  psa,
  // Serology
  dengue,
  "hiv-hbsag-vdrl": hivHbsagVdrl,
  widal,
  typhidot,
  "malaria-antigen": malariaAntigen,
  "crp-aso": crpAso,
  "ra-factor": raFactor,
  // Clinical pathology
  urine,
  upt,
  stool,
  semen,
} satisfies Record<string, ReportTemplate<any>>;

export type TemplateId = keyof typeof TEMPLATES;

/** Ready-made test bundles. */
export const PROFILES: Record<string, { name: string; tests: TemplateId[] }> = {
  "fever-profile": { name: "Fever Profile", tests: ["cbc", "mp", "widal", "dengue", "typhidot"] },
  "diabetes-profile": { name: "Diabetes Profile", tests: ["blood-sugar", "hba1c", "kft", "lipid", "urine"] },
  "liver-kidney-profile": { name: "Liver & Kidney Profile", tests: ["lft", "kft"] },
  "anemia-profile": { name: "Anaemia Profile", tests: ["cbc", "iron-profile", "vitamin-b12"] },
  "antenatal-profile": { name: "Antenatal (ANC) Profile", tests: ["cbc", "blood-group", "blood-sugar", "hiv-hbsag-vdrl", "thyroid", "urine"] },
  "pre-operative-profile": { name: "Pre-operative Profile", tests: ["cbc", "bt-ct", "pt-inr", "blood-group", "blood-sugar", "kft", "hiv-hbsag-vdrl"] },
  "full-body-checkup": {
    name: "Full Body Check-up",
    tests: ["cbc", "esr", "blood-sugar", "hba1c", "lft", "kft", "lipid", "thyroid", "vitamin-d", "vitamin-b12", "urine"],
  },
};

export type ProfileId = keyof typeof PROFILES;

export interface TestInput {
  template: TemplateId | ReportTemplate<any>;
  results: Results;
}

/**
 * Build a report from one or more tests.
 *
 *   buildReport(patient, [{ template: "hb", results: { hb: "10.1" } },
 *                         { template: "blood-sugar", results: { bsf: "102.0" } }])
 */
export function buildReport(patient: Patient, tests: TestInput[], opts: { endText?: string } = {}): Report {
  return {
    patient,
    endText: opts.endText,
    sections: tests.flatMap(({ template, results }) => {
      const tpl = typeof template === "string" ? TEMPLATES[template] : template;
      if (!tpl) throw new Error(`Unknown report template "${String(template)}"`);
      return tpl
        .build(results as never, { patient })
        .map((s) => ({ ...s, subtitle: s.subtitle ?? tpl.name, specimen: s.specimen ?? tpl.specimen, method: s.method ?? tpl.method }));
    }),
  };
}

/** Build a profile report. `results` is keyed by template id, e.g. { cbc: {...}, lft: {...} }. */
export function buildProfileReport(patient: Patient, profile: ProfileId, results: Partial<Record<TemplateId, Results>>): Report {
  const p = PROFILES[profile];
  if (!p) throw new Error(`Unknown profile "${profile}"`);
  return buildReport(
    patient,
    p.tests.map((id) => ({ template: id, results: results[id] ?? {} })),
  );
}
```

## File: src/server/templates/serology.ts

```ts
import type { Row, SectionStyle } from "../../shared/types";
import { COLS_RA, COLS_SEROLOGY, COLS_STD, COLS_WIDAL, fieldsOf, fillRows, h, panel, t, titre, type ReportTemplate, type Results } from "./helpers";

const RAPID = "(Performed on Jmitra Rapid test.)";
const NR = "Non- Reactive";

const rapidStyle: SectionStyle = {
  font: "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif",
  fontSize: 12,
  nameBold: true,
  resultBold: true,
  resultSize: 13,
  resultColor: "#00B0F0",
  headingSize: 10,
  headingGap: 12,
  methodSize: 12,
  methodGap: 9,
};

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- Dengue */

const dengueRows: Row[] = [
  h("Dengue Rapid Screening"),
  t("igg", "Dengue IgG", undefined, NR, { method: RAPID }),
  t("igm", "Dengue IgM", undefined, NR, { method: RAPID }),
  t("ns1", "Dengue NS1 Rapid", undefined, NR, { method: RAPID }),
];

export const dengue: ReportTemplate = {
  id: "dengue",
  name: "Dengue (IgG / IgM / NS1)",
  category: "Serology",
  specimen: "Serum",
  method: "Rapid Card Test",
  fields: fieldsOf(dengueRows),
  build: (r) => [
    { title: "IMMUNOLOGY/ SEROLOGY", columns: COLS_SEROLOGY, rows: fillRows(dengueRows, r), style: { ...rapidStyle, rowGap: 24 } },
  ],
  sample: { igg: "Non - Reactive", igm: "Non - Reactive", ns1: "Non - Reactive" },
};

/* --------------------------------------------------------- HIV / HBsAg / VDRL */
// Only the tests that have a result are printed.

const viralRows: Row[] = [
  t("hiv", "HIV 1&2", undefined, NR, { method: "(Performed on HIV Tridot Jmitra Make card test.)" }),
  t("hbsag", "HBsAg", undefined, NR, { method: RAPID }),
  t("vdrl", "VDRL", undefined, NR, { method: RAPID }),
  t("hcv", "HCV (Hepatitis C)", undefined, NR, { method: "(Performed on Rapid card test.)" }),
];

export const hivHbsagVdrl: ReportTemplate = {
  id: "hiv-hbsag-vdrl",
  name: "HIV / HBsAg / VDRL",
  category: "Serology",
  specimen: "Serum",
  fields: fieldsOf(viralRows),
  build: (r) => [
    {
      title: "IMMUNOLOGY/ SEROLOGY",
      columns: COLS_SEROLOGY,
      rows: fillRows(viralRows, r, true),
      style: { ...rapidStyle, methodSize: 11, methodGap: 9, rowGap: 14 },
    },
  ],
  sample: { hiv: "Non - Reactive", hbsag: "Non - Reactive" },
};

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------- Widal */

type Titres = [string, string, string, string, string];
export interface WidalResults extends Results {
  typhiO?: Titres;
  typhiH?: Titres;
  paraAH?: Titres;
  paraBH?: Titres;
  /** e.g. "Reactive" / "Non-Reactive" */
  impression?: string;
  note?: string;
}

const antigens: [keyof WidalResults, string, string][] = [
  ["typhiO", "Typhi", "‘O’"],
  ["typhiH", "Typhi", "‘H’"],
  ["paraAH", "Para-Typhi", "‘AH’"],
  ["paraBH", "Para-Typhi", "‘BH’"],
];

export const widal: ReportTemplate<WidalResults> = {
  id: "widal",
  name: "Widal Test",
  category: "Serology",
  specimen: "Serum",
  fields: [
    ...antigens.map(([key, a, b]) => ({ key: key as string, label: `${a} ${b} (1:40 … 1:640)` })),
    { key: "impression", label: "Impression" },
  ],
  build: (r) => {
    const rows: Row[] = antigens.map(([key, a, b]) => {
      const v = (r[key] as Titres | undefined) ?? ["-ve", "-ve", "-ve", "-ve", "-ve"];
      return { kind: "cells", cells: [{ text: a, bold: true }, { text: b, bold: true }, ...v.map(titre)] };
    });
    const impression = r.impression ?? "Non-Reactive";
    const reactive = /^reactive/i.test(impression.trim());
    rows.push(
      {
        kind: "text",
        indent: 0.14,
        spaceBefore: 26,
        content: [
          { text: "IMPRESSION – ", bold: true },
          { text: impression, bold: true, color: reactive ? "#FF0000" : undefined },
        ],
      },
      {
        kind: "text",
        indent: 0.14,
        spaceBefore: 4,
        content: [{ text: "Note: ", bold: true }, { text: r.note ?? "A diagnostic titre of 1:80 suggests positive reaction." }],
      },
    );
    return [{ title: "SEROLOGY", columns: COLS_WIDAL, rows, style: { rowGap: 11 } }];
  },
  sample: {
    typhiO: ["+ve", "+ve", "+ve", "-ve", "-ve"],
    typhiH: ["+ve", "+ve", "+ve", "-ve", "-ve"],
    paraAH: ["-ve", "-ve", "-ve", "-ve", "-ve"],
    paraBH: ["-ve", "-ve", "-ve", "-ve", "-ve"],
    impression: "Reactive",
  },
};

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- RA factor */

const raRows: Row[] = [t("ra", "RA Factor", undefined, "Negative")];

export const raFactor: ReportTemplate = {
  id: "ra-factor",
  name: "RA Factor",
  category: "Serology",
  specimen: "Serum",
  fields: fieldsOf(raRows),
  build: (r) => [
    {
      title: "RA FACTOR",
      columns: COLS_RA,
      rows: fillRows(raRows, r),
      style: { titleSpacing: 1.5, nameBold: true, resultBold: true, rangeBold: true },
    },
  ],
  sample: { ra: "Negative" },
};

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Typhidot */

export const typhidot = panel({
```

## File: src/shared/api.ts

```ts
// The contract between the browser client and the backend API. Types + route names only —
// no rendering code lives here, so importing it costs nothing in a client bundle.
import type { ProfileId, Results, TemplateId } from "../server/templates";
import type { Patient, Report, ReportDesign, ReportVariant } from "./types";

export type { ProfileId, Results, TemplateId };

/** Default mount point of the backend handler */
export const DEFAULT_BASE_PATH = "/api/mgpl";

/** Routes, relative to the base path */
export const ROUTES = {
  health: "/health",
  templates: "/templates",
  samples: "/samples",
  report: "/report",
  letterhead: "/letterhead",
  assets: "/assets",
} as const;

export type OutputFormat = "pdf" | "html";

/**
 * POST /report body. Send ONE of:
 *  - `patient` + `tests` (template ids + results, built on the server)
 *  - `patient` + `profile`
 *  - `report` (an already built Report)
 *  - `sample` (demo id, only when the server enables samples)
 */
export interface ReportRequest {
  patient?: Patient;
  tests?: { template: TemplateId; results: Results }[];
  profile?: { id: ProfileId; results: Partial<Record<TemplateId, Results>> };
  report?: Report;
  sample?: string;
  /** default "header" */
  variant?: ReportVariant;
  /** default "sidebar" */
  design?: ReportDesign;
  /** default "pdf" */
  format?: OutputFormat;
  /** PDF only: send as a download with this name */
  fileName?: string;
  download?: boolean;
}

/** GET /templates */
export interface TemplateCatalog {
  templates: TemplateInfo[];
  profiles: { id: ProfileId; name: string; tests: TemplateId[] }[];
}
export interface TemplateInfo {
  id: TemplateId;
  name: string;
  category?: string;
  specimen?: string;
  method?: string;
  /** result keys to send in `tests[].results` */
  fields: { key: string; label: string; unit?: string; range?: string | string[] }[];
}

/** GET /samples (demo) */
export interface SampleInfo {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  group: "design" | "template" | "profile";
  source: string;
}

/** Error body for any non-2xx response */
export interface ApiError {
  error: string;
}
```


---

## File: src/shared/types.ts

```ts
/** "header"     = full letterhead (logo, address, email/mobile footer) — for plain paper / PDF.
 *  "non-header" = top left blank for pre-printed letterhead paper; only QC stamp + signature. */
export type ReportVariant = "header" | "non-header";

/** "sidebar" = Navy Sidebar design (default); "classic" = replica of the original Word designs. */
export type ReportDesign = "sidebar" | "classic";

export interface Patient {
  /** Salutation before the name, e.g. "Mr", "Mrs", "Master", "Ku" */
  title?: string;
  name: string;
  /** e.g. 32 or "6 Month" */
  age: number | string;
  /** Default "Year(s)" */
  ageUnit?: string;
  sex: string;
  /** e.g. "MGPL398" — printed as a scannable Code 39 barcode (bwip-js) */
  patientId?: string;
  /** e.g. "Self", "A. Verma". "Dr. " is added unless it already starts with "Dr". */
  refDoctor?: string;
  /** Date or preformatted string; printed DD-MM-YYYY. Defaults to today. */
  sampleCollectionDate?: Date | string;
  /** Lab sample / accession number */
  sampleId?: string;
  /** Used on invoices */
  phone?: string;
  address?: string;
  /** e.g. "Whole Blood (EDTA)". Defaults to the specimens of the tests on the report. */
  sampleType?: string;
  /** Date or preformatted "12-10-2026 08:45 AM". Falls back to sampleCollectionDate. */
  collectedAt?: Date | string;
  registeredAt?: Date | string;
  reportedAt?: Date | string;
}

/** A piece of text with optional formatting. */
export interface TextRun {
  text: string;
  bold?: boolean;
  italic?: boolean;
  /** CSS colour, e.g. "#FF0000" */
  color?: string;
  /** Font size in pt */
  size?: number;
  font?: string;
}

export type Rich = string | TextRun | TextRun[];

export type Align = "left" | "center" | "right";

/** "auto" (default) compares a numeric result with the reference range. */
export type Flag = "auto" | "normal" | "high" | "low" | "abnormal";

export interface Column {
  /** "name" | "result" | "unit" | "range" for test rows; anything for `cells` rows */
  key: string;
  header: string;
  /** Width in inches */
  width: number;
  /** Alignment of the values */
  align?: Align;
  /** Alignment of the header text (defaults to `align`) */
  headerAlign?: Align;
  /** Extra left padding of values, inches */
  padLeft?: number;
  /** Extra left padding of the header text, inches (default 0.08 = Word cell margin) */
  headerPadLeft?: number;
  /** Header cell spans this many columns (e.g. "WIDAL TEST" over two columns) */
  headerSpan?: number;
}

/** Sub-heading inside a section, e.g. "COMPLETE BLOOD COUNT", "PHYSICAL EXAMINATION". */
export interface HeadingRow {
  kind: "heading";
  text: string;
  size?: number;
  color?: string;
}

/** Normal test line: name | result | unit | range */
export interface TestRow {
  kind: "test";
  /** Key used to fill results, e.g. "hb" */
  key?: string;
  name: string;
  /** Bold suffix after the name, e.g. "(HB)" */
  abbr?: string;
  result?: string;
  unit?: string;
  /** One line, or several lines (Lipid profile risk bands) */
  range?: string | string[];
  /** Sex-specific ranges; picked from the patient's sex when the report is built */
  rangeBySex?: { male: string; female: string };
  flag?: Flag;
  /** Override result colour */
  resultColor?: string;
  /** Italic method line under the test, e.g. "(Performed on Jmitra Rapid test.)" */
  method?: string;
}

/** Free cells, for grids like the Widal titre table and Semen analysis. */
export interface CellsRow {
  kind: "cells";
  cells: Rich[];
}

/** Full-width paragraph, e.g. "IMPRESSION – Reactive". */
export interface TextRow {
  kind: "text";
  content: Rich;
  /** Left indent, inches */
  indent?: number;
  /** Space before, pt */
  spaceBefore?: number;
}

export type Row = HeadingRow | TestRow | CellsRow | TextRow;

/** Typography + colour knobs for one section (each template sets these to match its design). */
export interface SectionStyle {
  /** Title size in pt (Arial Black). Default 12 */
  titleSize?: number;
  /** Title letter spacing in pt */
  titleSpacing?: number;
  /** Row font size in pt. Default 11 */
  fontSize?: number;
  /** Row font family override (Dengue / HIV use Arial) */
  font?: string;
  /** Heading row size in pt. Default 11 */
  headingSize?: number;
  /** Space after each row, pt. Default 6 */
  rowGap?: number;
  /** Min height of each row, pt */
  rowHeight?: number;
  nameBold?: boolean;
  nameSize?: number;
  /** Colour of in-range results. Default black. CBC uses "#00B0F0". */
  resultColor?: string;
  resultBold?: boolean;
  resultSize?: number;
  unitBold?: boolean;
  /** Font size for multi-line ranges, pt */
  rangeSize?: number;
  rangeFont?: string;
  rangeBold?: boolean;
  /** Abnormal results colour. Default "#FF0000" */
  abnormalColor?: string;
  /** Abnormal results bold. Default true */
  abnormalBold?: boolean;
  /** Method line size, pt */
  methodSize?: number;
  /** Space between a test and its method line, pt. Default 6 */
  methodGap?: number;
  /** Space after heading rows, pt (default = rowGap) */
  headingGap?: number;
  /** Row content left indent, inches */
  indent?: number;
}

export interface Section {
  /** Department title in the blue band, e.g. "HEMATOLOGY" */
  title: string;
  /** Test / panel name, e.g. "Complete Blood Count (CBC)". Set from the template. */
  subtitle?: string;
  /** e.g. "Whole Blood (EDTA)" */
  specimen?: string;
  /** e.g. "Automated Cell Counter" */
  method?: string;
  columns: Column[];
  /** Hide the column header row (Semen Analysis) */
  hideColumnHeader?: boolean;
  rows: Row[];
  /** Full report width like the title bar (CBC). Default = within page margins. */
  wide?: boolean;
  style?: SectionStyle;
  /** Start this section on a new A4 page */
  pageBreakBefore?: boolean;
}

/** Every image is just a URL: "/report-assets/logo.svg", "https://…", or a data: URI.
 *  Swap them in one place (lab.ts) — SVG and PNG both work. */
export interface LabProfile {
  name: string;
  logoSrc: string;
  addressLines: string[];
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  signatory: {
    name: string;
    designation: string;
    /** Signature on the header (letterhead) variant */
    signatureHeaderSrc: string;
    /** Signature on the non-header variant */
    signatureNonHeaderSrc: string;
  };
  qcStampSrc?: string;
  icons: { emailSrc: string; phoneSrc: string };
  /** Vertical text in the sidebar (Navy Sidebar design). Defaults to the lab name in capitals. */
  sidebarText?: string;
  /** Lines printed in the letterhead footer (Navy Sidebar design) */
  footerLines?: string[];
  /** If set, the QR code links to `${verifyBaseUrl}${sampleId ?? patientId}`; otherwise it
   *  encodes a plain-text summary of the report. */
  verifyBaseUrl?: string;
  /* ---- billing (invoice kit) ---- */
  /** UPI ID (VPA) for the "scan to pay" QR on invoices, e.g. "mgpl@okaxis" */
  upiId?: string;
  /** Printed on invoices when the lab is GST registered */
  gstin?: string;
  /** Clinical establishment / lab registration number */
  registrationNo?: string;
  /** Terms printed at the bottom of invoices */
  invoiceTerms?: string[];
}

export interface Report {
  patient: Patient;
  sections: Section[];
  /** Defaults to "--End of Report--" */
  endText?: string;
  /** Override what the QR code encodes */
  qrValue?: string;
}
```
